jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.


The wage range

jobs.title: Customer Service Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking an energetic and detail\-oriented Customer Service Logistics Coordinator to join our dynamic logistics team which operates our new fashion\-distribution center. In this pivotal role, you will be the key liaison between our warehouse operations, transportation providers, and fashion clients, ensuring seamless coordination of logistics activities. Your expertise will drive process improvements, optimize inventory management, and enhance customer satisfaction through proactive communication and strategic problem\-solving. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and are passionate about fashion and supply chain excellence, this opportunity is for you!

**Duties**

* Manage order fulfillment processes, including receiving \& shipping, ensuring timely and accurate delivery to customers.
* Coordinate transportation planning and logistics management using transportation management systems (TMS) and warehouse management systems (WMS).
* Oversee warehouse distribution activities, including inbound receiving, stocking, inventory control and shipping to maximize efficiency.
* Utilize data analysis skills with tools like Power\-BI and other specialized reporting to monitor supply chain performance metrics and identify areas for process improvement.
* Conduct root cause analysis on warehouse operations and transportation delays to implement effective corrective actions.
* Facilitate cross\-functional communication among warehouse floor operations, planning, freight carriers, and customers to ensure compliance with established SLA.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in a supply chain operations role with strong knowledge of warehouse experience.
* Demonstrated ability in team management, shipping logistics and freight management.
* Proficiency in data collection and analysis, skills in Excel data analysis, and supply chain analytics to support decision\-making.
* Familiarity with warehouse management systems (WMS), transportation management systems (TMS), inventory control practices, and labor management.
* Excellent communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration and customer service excellence.
* Strong problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on process improvement initiatives within logistics operations.

Join us as a Customer Service Logistics Coordinator to be at the heart of our supply chain excellence! Your expertise will help us deliver outstanding service while continuously enhancing our logistics strategies through innovative thinking and proactive solutions.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $34\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Production Planning & Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
Certified Enameling is seeking an experienced, tech\-forward Production PlanningLogistics Coordinator to help manage customer orders through our metal finishing and manufacturing operations.


We need someone who is comfortable using ERP systems, digital schedules, dashboards, spreadsheets, and real\-time production data. This person must be able to replace manual follow\-up with organized, system\-driven processes.


Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate daily production priorities, receiving, and outbound shipments.
* Track orders from receiving through production, quality control, packing, and  

shipment.
* Maintain accurate work orders, schedules, due dates, and shipment information in  

our ERP system.
* Use system data and production dashboards to identify delays and scheduling  

conflicts.
* Work directly with production leads to keep jobs moving on schedule.
* Coordinate urgent orders and customer\-specific deadlines.
* Communicate order updates with customers, vendors, carriers, and internal  

teams.
* Schedule customer pickups, company deliveries, and outside carriers.
* Improve digital workflows, reporting, scheduling accuracy, and on\-time delivery.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual entry, paperwork, and repetitive  

administrative work.


Qualifications

* Three or more years of production planning, scheduling, logistics, or  

order\-coordination experience in manufacturing.
* Strong working knowledge of ERP systems, digital scheduling tools, and  

Microsoft Excel.
* Comfortable learning new technology and improving existing processes.
* Able to use data to prioritize work, solve problems, and communicate production  

status.
* Metal finishing, powder coating, painting, anodizing, plating, or fabrication  

experience is strongly preferred.
* Strong organization, communication, and follow\-through.
* Odoo experience is highly preferred.
* Bilingual English and Spanish is a plus.


Ideal Candidate


You are proactive, organized, comfortable with technology, and willing to work directly with both office and production teams. You do not rely on paper, memory, or verbal updates alone. You use systems, accurate data, and clear communication to keep production moving.


Benefits

* 401(k)
* Full\-time, consistent schedule
* Monday through Friday


Pay: $26\.00\-$28\.00 per hour  

Location: Los Angeles, CA \- In person  

Schedule: Full\-time, Monday through Friday

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator / Sales Assistant (Off-Price Retail)
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Célavi is a fast\-growing beauty and personal care company specializing in licensed and branded products sold across major off\-price retailers including Ross, Burlington, and TJX. We are a fast\-paced, detail\-driven team looking for someone who can support our sales operations and grow with the company.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a **sharp, detail\-oriented Sales Coordinator / Assistant** to support our sales team, specifically within the off\-price retail channel. This role is critical in ensuring orders, pricing, and product details are executed accurately and efficiently.

This is a great opportunity for someone who is **organized, quick to learn, and thrives in a fast\-moving environment**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and manage **sales orders and purchase orders**
* Maintain and update **internal tracking sheets and order logs**
* Communicate with internal teams (sales, production, logistics) to ensure accuracy and timelines
* Assist with **pricing sheets, item setup, and product information**
* Track **PP samples and TOP samples** and follow up as needed
* Support sales team with **day\-to\-day operational tasks**
* Ensure all data and documentation is **accurate and up to date**

**Qualifications**

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy (this is critical)
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks at once
* Quick learner with a proactive mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Basic computer skills required:
* Excel (data entry, basic formulas)
* Email and general office software
* Strong communication skills

**Preferred (Not Required)**

* Experience working with retailers such as Ross, TJX, Burlington, etc.
* Experience in consumer goods, beauty, or wholesale
* Familiarity with order processing or inventory systems

**What We’re Looking For**

* Someone **reliable and accountable**
* Someone who **catches mistakes before they happen**
* Someone who wants to **learn and grow within the company**

Pay: $23\.00 \- $28\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Opportunities for advancement

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Post Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Post Production Coordinator supports the execution of post\-production activities across theatrical, streaming, and animation projects. This role focuses on administrative coordination, operational support, and cross\-functional alignment to ensure projects progress efficiently from pre\-production through final delivery. The Coordinator partners with Post Production leaders and works closely with Production, Editorial, and Studio teams to maintain schedules, track deliverables, and support day\-to\-day operations.

**Responsibilities:**
=====================

**Production \& Post Coordination**
-----------------------------------

* Act as a day\-to\-day liaison and point of contact for Editorial and Post teams across assigned projects
* Support coordination across Production, VFX, and internal studio teams
* Track and maintain production and post\-production milestones

**Scheduling, Reporting \& Communications**
-------------------------------------------

* Maintain show calendars, production schedules, and departmental timelines
* Coordinate meetings, conference calls, and executive sessions
* Update tracking systems and support executive reporting
* Document key meeting updates and action items

**Editorial \& Post Operations**
--------------------------------

* Assist with editorial room setup and ensure systems and access are in place
* Support onboarding of editorial and post personnel, including account setup and access management

**Vendor, Facilities \& Logistics**
-----------------------------------

* Assist in securing editorial office space and coordinating setup
* Coordinate travel, housing, and logistics for editorial teams
* Support shipping and equipment coordination for remote locations
* Help maintain vendor coordination and service needs

**Financial \& Administrative Support**
---------------------------------------

* Create and track purchase orders and invoices.
* Maintain, collect, and audit physical assets provided by the Post Production team. You will maintain records of when assets are checked in and out.

**Screenings \& Reviews**
-------------------------

* Coordinate logistics for internal and executive screenings, including scheduling and room setup.
* Assist in managing Executive Screening Room.
* Support review processes and ensure materials are available.

**Delivery \& Distribution Support**
------------------------------------

* Assist in coordinating final delivery, including quality control and master approvals.
* Partner with distribution teams to support delivery timelines.

**Documentation \& Process Support**
------------------------------------

* Maintain documentation related to workflows, onboarding, and procedures.
* Support development and upkeep of operational guidelines.

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* 1\+ years of production/post production experience; or relevant internship experience.
* Strong organizational skills, ability to multi\-task and organize multiple projects, with excellent follow through.
* Strong communication skills, with an ability to interface with 3rd party vendors, internal executives and staff in a collaborative and problem\-solving fashion.
* Ability to anticipate and resolve routine questions or issues while keeping senior executives aware of project status.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with Physical production and/or Post production previous Studio Production experience preferred.
* Familiarity post calendars and applications.

  

The hiring range for this position in Burbank, CA is $53,200 to $68,700 per year based on a 40 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: Publicity Coordinator (Disney Entertainment Television)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**


Disney Entertainment Television is seeking a Publicity Coordinator to support publicity campaigns and day\-to\-day communications activities across its portfolio of television programming and content. Working closely with publicists, executives, and cross\-functional partners, the Coordinator will provide administrative, project\-management, and campaign support for series, specials, documentaries, movies, and other programming.

  

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, proactive, and energized by a fast\-paced, creative environment. This role requires strong written and verbal communication skills, the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, and an interest in developing a career in entertainment publicity. The Coordinator will contribute to the planning and execution of publicity campaigns, events, talent activities, press outreach, and departmental operations.

 **Responsibilities**

  

* Monitor, track, and compile press coverage, social media activity, industry news, and publicity results for internal and external reporting.
* Create and maintain press lists, media contacts, show contact sheets, campaign calendars, status reports, and other departmental resources.
* Research media outlets, journalists, industry trends, pop\-culture developments, and potential publicity opportunities.
* Draft, edit, and distribute publicity materials, which may include press releases, announcements, pitches, biographies, fact sheets, loglines, press blasts, confirmation memos, and social media copy.
* Gather, organize, and distribute publicity assets, including images, clips, screeners, press materials, mailers, and promotional items.
* Support the planning and execution of publicity campaigns, launches, initiatives, and events.
* Assist with events such as press junkets, screenings, panels, premieres, press tours, award shows, and other industry or company events, including occasional evenings and weekends.
* Coordinate talent\-related logistics, including travel, schedules, itineraries, interviews, event participation, and other publicity needs.
* Provide administrative support to publicity executives and the broader department, including calendar management, meeting coordination, conference calls, note\-taking, expense reports, and general scheduling.
* Maintain publicity\-related materials and information across internal systems, media sites, presentations, and shared departmental resources.
* Assist with purchase orders, invoices, contracts, expenses, budgets, vendor onboarding, and other campaign or departmental processes as needed.
* Participate in campaign brainstorms and contribute ideas for press angles, pitches, events, and promotional opportunities.
* Collaborate with internal partners across marketing, creative, media, social, production, and other business areas.
* Communicate professionally with external partners, including talent, talent representatives, production teams, public relations agencies, vendors, and members of the media.
* Provide additional project, campaign, and administrative support as assigned.

 **Basic Qualifications**

  

* Minimum 1 year of related experience in publicity, communications, marketing, entertainment, or a comparable professional environment.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate, current information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, demanding, and collaborative environment.
* Proactive, resourceful, and solutions\-oriented approach to work.
* Ability to take direction, exercise sound judgment, and adapt as priorities evolve.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders at different levels.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Outlook, Google Workspace, or comparable productivity and presentation tools.
* Familiarity with major social media platforms and current entertainment and pop\-culture trends.
* Ability to provide on\-site support at publicity events, including occasional evening and weekend work.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Minimum 2 years previous publicity or marketing experience at a television network, streaming platform, studio, production company, agency, or related entertainment organization.
* Familiarity with media\-monitoring, press\-database, or communications platforms such as Muck Rack, TVEyes, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting publicity campaigns, entertainment events, talent logistics, or media relations.
* Demonstrated interest in television, streaming, entertainment, and the evolving media landscape.
* Desire and ability to take on increasing levels of responsibility.

 **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

  


The hiring range for this position in Burbank, CA is $54,000 to $72,300 per year based on a 40\-hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: Campus Operations and Events Coordinator
jobs.description:

The incumbent will serve as the first point of contact for visitors and callers and in many instances may provide supervision of students and will direct students and parents/guardians to the appropriate department/program.Is critical and essential that the incumbent have a basic understanding of risk management strategies and mitigation procedures in regard to health, safety and facilities and work continuously to broaden their knowledge, skills and abilities as there will be day to day occurrences where good judgement and mitigation measures will have to be executed and reported accordingly.The incumbent will also assist with a broad range of administrative customer service and clerical functions in support of the Geffen Academy at UCLA. jobs.description:
Advocate Media Company is the media and marketing engine behind its client, Sina Rez Law, a consumer protection law firm with a founder who is also a car guy and the on\-camera talent for everything we make.

We publish short\-form content daily across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, and we're building an in\-house content team around it: a lead videographer, a creative director, and you.

This is a two\-sided role. Half of it is distribution: everything we produce gets posted, packaged, and worked across every platform, on schedule, every day. The other half is production: on shoot days, you're the videographer's right hand, and the set runs on your logistics.

Distribution: what you'll own

* Publishing: the daily posting calendar across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Captions, hashtags, cover frames, scheduling. You keep the calendar moving and make sure everything goes out clean, accurate, and on time.
* Community: comments and DMs, every day. You know which comments to answer, which to pin, which to flag as content ideas, and which need to be escalated.
* Repurposing logistics: one video becomes multiple assets across platforms. You run that pipeline between our videographer and editors.
* The numbers: a simple weekly performance report covering what worked, what didn't, and what the team should test next.

Production: what you'll own

* Shoot\-day logistics: scheduling, locations, props, releases, and prep, including loading the teleprompter before the talent walks in.
* Set support: setup and teardown alongside the videographer, gear organized and accounted for, and the day kept on schedule.
* Media management: footage is backed up, labeled consistently, organized, and handed off to editors the same day it's shot.
* Behind\-the\-scenes capture when the moment's worth it.

Who this is for

* You spend enough time online to understand why certain videos take off, what makes a hook work, and how content behaves differently across platforms.
* You understand what tends to work on each platform and pay attention when those patterns change.
* You're ruthlessly organized. Calendars, checklists, and pipelines are how you think, and you're equally happy on a set or behind a spreadsheet in the same day.
* You like fast\-moving environments where there's always something to publish, prep, organize, or improve.
* Early career is fine. Hunger and consistency beat years of experience for this seat.
* Cars are a plus, not a requirement.

Comp and growth

$55,000–$65,000 depending on experience.

This is a full\-time, in\-person role in Woodland Hills on a content team with a real budget behind it. A Creative Director is being recruited to help lead the team as it grows.

You'll be in the room while a brand's content operation gets built, not maintaining one that's already finished. From this seat, you can grow into producer, social lead, or post\-production paths depending on where you shine.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Los Angeles-based
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  

Counterintuity, a marketing agency dedicated to helping nonprofits achieve their mission, is seeking a highly organized and client\-focused, Los Angeles\-based **Account Manager** to join our agency team. This role requires someone who can balance strategic thinking, relationship management, and campaign execution — serving as the primary liaison between our agency and its clients while ensuring seamless communication, alignment, and delivery across every account.  

Because this role is dedicated entirely to supporting our nonprofit client roster, compensation for this position is benchmarked to nonprofit\-sector marketing and account management roles rather than traditional commercial agency pay scales — reflecting both the mission\-driven nature of the work and the realities of nonprofit client budgets.  

  

**Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities**  

As an Account Manager at our agency, you will be responsible for:* Serving as the **primary point of contact** for clients — keeping them happy, aligned, and confident in our work.
* Managing **select integrated digital marketing campaigns** across content strategy, social media, and search marketing.
* Optimizing **campaign performance** and pushing for the best possible client outcomes.
* Overseeing **timelines, budgets, and deliverables**, and coordinating closely with the production team to keep work on track and on budget.
* Coordinating with the **production team**, assigning and QAing work precisely, and achieving results on time and on budget.
* Identifying and pursuing **growth opportunities** within your accounts.
* Supporting the **Director of Client Services** and staying current on industry trends and best practices.
* Staying informed on **industry trends** and best practices to provide clients with innovative marketing solutions.

**Key Areas of Responsibility and Time Allocation**  

**Client Communication and Strategy (50%)*** Serve as the primary client contact, ensuring a strong relationship and high satisfaction levels.
* Develop and present strategic recommendations to align campaigns with client business goals.
* Proactively manage expectations, addressing challenges and opportunities in real time.

**Campaign Management (30%)*** Oversee project timelines, budgets, and deliverables, ensuring all campaigns are executed efficiently.
* Work closely with internal teams to maintain quality control and alignment on project objectives.
* Monitor campaign performance and recommend optimizations as needed.

**Internal Collaboration (20%)*** Work cross\-functionally with creative, media, and strategy teams to execute client initiatives.
* Maintain strong internal communication, ensuring that all teams are aligned on client expectations.
* Assist in the development of client presentations and reports to showcase campaign results.

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)*** **Client Satisfaction \& Retention** – Maintain an 85%\+ client satisfaction and retention rate.
* **Project Execution** – Ensure 95%\+ of projects are completed on time and within budget.
* **Account Growth** – Think strategically, pursue growth opportunities, and grow your personally managed annual book of business by 10%.
* **Campaign Performance** – Improve marketing metrics such as engagement, conversions, and ROI through strategic adjustments.

  

**Required Skills**  

**Hard Skills:*** **3 years of experience** in account management, marketing, or client services within an agency or marketing firm.
* Strong understanding of marketing strategy, campaign execution, and project management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, keeping them on time and within budget.
* Proficiency in marketing analytics, CRM platforms, and project management software.
* Strong business acumen with an ability to identify opportunities for growth within accounts.

**Soft Skills:*** Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong organizational and time management abilities.
* Detail\-oriented approach with a problem\-solving mindset.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Collaborative and proactive approach to internal teamwork and client engagement.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and adaptability, with a demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with team members.

  

**30\-60\-90 Day Onboarding Plan**  

**First 30 Days:*** Learn agency processes, tools, and workflows.
* Review existing client accounts and gain an understanding of their business goals.
* Meet with internal teams and leadership to establish key working relationships.
* Observe ongoing campaigns and projects to understand execution strategies.

**60 Days:*** Take full ownership of assigned accounts, acting as the lead point of contact.
* Begin managing project timelines, budgets, and deliverables independently.
* Identify potential process improvements for more efficient account management.
* Contribute to client presentations and strategy discussions.

**90 Days:*** Identify and present opportunities for account growth, such as additional services or expanded scope.
* Lead client meetings, providing strategic insights and recommendations.
* Establish long\-term success strategies for assigned accounts to improve retention and performance.
* Set personal and professional development goals to enhance skills in account management.

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**  

This role requires a highly organized and client\-focused professional who can balance strategic thinking, relationship management, and campaign execution. The ideal Account Manager is a strong communicator, proactive problem solver, and detail\-oriented project manager who thrives in a fast\-paced, client\-driven environment. They must be comfortable managing multiple campaigns simultaneously, working cross\-functionally with internal teams, and identifying growth opportunities within accounts.  

  

**Compensation and Benefits**  

B

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys building customer relationships, developing new business, identifying product opportunities, and working directly with retail buyers.

You will work with both existing and prospective retail customers across grocery, value, specialty, convenience, drug, and other retail channels. From identifying an opportunity and presenting products to securing purchase orders and supporting the account afterward, you will play an important role in growing PPNC's retail business.

What You'll Do

**Grow Retail Sales**

* Manage and develop assigned retail accounts.
* Build strong relationships with buyers, assistant buyers, planners, and other customer contacts.
* Identify opportunities for new products, seasonal programs, reorders, additional categories, and expanded distribution.
* Present available inventory, new products, and relevant programs to customers.
* Work toward measurable account growth and sales results.

**Develop New Business**

* Prospect and develop new retail customers.
* Research prospective retailers and identify appropriate buyer contacts.
* Conduct outreach through email, phone, LinkedIn, trade shows, referrals, and other sales channels.
* Secure buyer meetings and present PPNC products and capabilities.
* Maintain an active pipeline of prospects and sales opportunities.

**Present Products \& Ideas**

* Prepare for buyer meetings, line reviews, product presentations, and customer visits.
* Create and coordinate presentations, line sheets, pricing sheets, assortment proposals, and samples.
* Follow up consistently after presentations and sample deliveries.
* Help move opportunities from initial conversation through purchase order.

**Identify Product \& Retail Trends**

* Stay current on trends in toys, play balls, novelty, impulse, collectibles, sensory products, squish, and seasonal merchandise.
* Research retailers, competitors, social media, marketplaces, and consumer trends.
* Identify products, themes, colors, packaging concepts, price points, and assortment opportunities that may appeal to retail customers.
* Share market insights with the sales and design teams.

**Support Customer\-Specific Product Development**

* Work with PPNC's design and product teams to develop programs for individual retailers.
* Communicate buyer feedback and customer requirements to internal teams.
* Help guide product selection, target retail pricing, packaging, themes, colors, and assortments.
* Coordinate revisions and follow\-up based on customer feedback.

**Own the Customer Follow\-Through**

* Stay informed and involved after a purchase order is received.
* Review purchase orders for basic accuracy, including products, quantities, pricing, ship dates, cancel dates, and customer requirements.
* Track important customer deadlines and communicate internally with operations, logistics, production, design, and management.
* Identify potential issues early and help coordinate solutions before they impact the customer.
* Maintain accurate account, opportunity, and project information in Monday.com and other company systems.

What We're Looking For

* 1–3\+ years of experience in sales, business development, account support, retail, consumer products, toys, gifts, novelty, or a related field preferred.

* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Comfortable prospecting and developing new business.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple customers, projects, and deadlines.

* Comfortable working independently while collaborating across departments.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and similar business tools.
* Experience with Monday.com, CRM platforms, or project\-management systems is a plus.
* Interest in retail products, consumer trends, toys, and emerging product opportunities.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position means growing assigned accounts, developing new retail customers, building strong buyer relationships, converting presentations into purchase orders, identifying new product opportunities, and consistently following through on customer commitments.

We're looking for someone who doesn't simply wait for opportunities—someone who actively looks for the next customer, product, program, reorder, or sales opportunity.

Compensation

**Starting Base Salary: $73,000–$83,000 per year**

Final compensation will be based on relevant experience, qualifications, retail sales background, and demonstrated ability to develop and grow customer accounts.

**About PPNC**

PPNC is a consumer\-products company specializing in toys, play balls, squish products, novelty items, and other fun and trend\-driven merchandise sold through retail channels.

This is an opportunity to join a hands\-on team where sales works closely with product development, design, operations, logistics, and leadership to bring products from concept to retail shelves.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Saddleback Communications Team serves as the Creative \& Marketing talent for Saddleback Church. What we do touches every aspect of our church and is, most times, the first exposure individuals get to Saddleback Church.



We use graphics, photography, social media, email marketing, personalized messaging, and storytelling to showcase who we are as a church community and, through it, impact the community and world around us.



This position is the connective tissue of our team. He/she owns the church\-wide communication calendar — the single place where every promotion, series, and event lives — and makes sure the weekend actually happens: host scripts written, assets delivered to Production and Experience on time, signage thought through, Church News supported. Are you the person who sees the whole board, keeps a dozen moving pieces on schedule, and writes well while doing it?



Saddleback Church is looking for a Marketing Coordinator who loves bringing order to creative work so that what our church says on any given weekend is clear, on time, and on mission.


**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**


**WEEKEND COMMUNICATIONS COORDINATION**


* Write weekend host scripts and announcement copy, tailored to the host and aligned with established on\-camera conventions and the Saddleback voice.
* Coordinate and deliver weekend and event assets to the Production and Experience teams on schedule — signs, screens, motion, lower thirds, script versions, and run\-of\-show communication needs.
* Support Church News: gather and prioritize announcement content, prepare and route drafts, and coordinate revisions with the host, video producer, and Marketing Director.
* Serve as the weekend point of contact for communications questions and be present at weekends and key events as required.


**COMMUNICATION CALENDAR MANAGEMENT**


* Own and maintain the church\-wide communication and promotions calendar — the authoritative view of what is being promoted, on which channels, and when.
* Manage the process for promotional campaign builds; apply agreed\-upon prioritization criteria and flag conflicts, over\-promotion, and gaps before they reach the congregation.
* Assist with sequencing promotions against the master calendar, message series, and major church\-wide initiatives so campaigns launch with adequate lead time.
* Communicate calendar decisions and deadlines clearly to Communications, ministry, and weekend teams, maintaining a high level of customer service across teams.
* Keep the calendar and supporting systems current, and assist with maintaining marketing dashboards and assessment tools.


**WEEKLY DELIVERABLES AND PROJECT COORDINATION**


* Manage communication projects and campaigns from inception to completion as assigned.
* Support the development and deployment of communication plans within desired timelines that accomplish marketing goals and align with the mission and vision of Saddleback Church.


**COPYWRITING, EDITING, AND PROOFREADING**


* Write and edit copy provided by the Communications team, other teams, and pastoral staff.
* Proofread copy to identify and fix errors in grammar, spelling, and punctuation before anything reaches the congregation.
* Uphold and steward the Saddleback voice as defined by the Editorial Style Guide.
* Assist with content curation, research on projects, and corroboration of facts and substance of content.


**DECISION MAKING**


* Empowered to make decisions within the function of the Marketing Team — including calendar sequencing, weekend asset deadlines, and script and copy edits — escalating strategy and priority conflicts to the Marketing Director.


**OTHER**


* Perform a variety of duties including but not limited to: special projects, assisting other teams, research, and filling in where requested.


**WHO YOU ARE:**


* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to communicate complex ideas and projects in a clear and effective way.
* Impeccable grammar and a strong proofreading eye.
* Script and announcement writing for live and on\-camera delivery, or a demonstrated ability to learn it quickly.
* Exceptional organization; able to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously without dropping details.
* Calm and clear under weekend timelines; comfortable making the call when an asset is late.
* Organized, creative, and confident, valuing research and accuracy.
* Highly relational; able to work as a team player and discuss needs, challenges, and ideas across teams.
* Thrives in supporting and enabling a collaborative culture aimed toward building better results.
* Proficient knowledge of Google Suite; working knowledge of Adobe CS preferred.
* Sound understanding of marketing principles, effective project management, and excellent organizational skills.


**WHAT YOU HAVE DONE:**


* 1\-3\+ years of working experience required.
* 2\+ years of experience writing or editing marketing copy for digital and print platforms.
* Experience coordinating projects, calendars, or production schedules across multiple stakeholders.
* An ideal candidate has prior experience in church or para\-church communications, or experience in external or in\-house agencies in a similar function.


**EDUCATION**


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, English, Communications, or a related field preferred.


**WHAT WE OFFER**


* Highly competitive benefits plans. Health plans with employee low deductible medical (EPO and PPO), dental, and vision coverage.
* 403(b)\-retirement plan with employer contribution.
* Generous holiday and paid time off plans, including a paid week off between Christmas and New Year’s Day.

**Outreach Coordinator (Part\-Time, 20 Hours/Week, Afternoons \& Evenings)** 

Partners4Wellness (P4W) seeks a compassionate and motivated **Outreach Coordinator** to facilitate life\-skills and resiliency workshops for youth involved in the juvenile justice system. This entry\-level position is ideal for recent graduates who are passionate about supporting under\-served youth through mentorship, skill\-building, and community engagement.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Life Skills and Resiliency Workshops

* Facilitate interactive, evidence\-based life\-skills and resiliency workshops for youth and transitional\-age youth (TAY) ages 16\-25 in Juvenile Hall, the Youth Guidance Center, the Youth Leadership Academy, and other youth\-serving organizations.
* Create a welcoming, respectful, strength\-based, and trauma\-informed group environment.
* Provide guidance, mentorship, and support to participants, helping them develop coping strategies, problem\-solving skills, and goal\-setting techniques.
* Build positive, professional relationships with participants while maintaining appropriate boundaries and modeling effective communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Connect youth to community resources and support services that promote successful reentry.

Curriculum Support

* Maintain and update curriculum materials, participant workbooks, and community resource guides to ensure relevance and alignment with youth needs and best practices.
* Support the enhancement and occasional development of new curriculum content, workshop activities, and resource materials based on program needs.
* Stay updated on trends in youth development, trauma\-informed care, and community resources.

Community Engagement and Collaboration

* Establish rapport and maintain positive relationships with Probation staff, site coordinators, and other programming partners.
* Represent P4W at community and stakeholder meetings to promote life\-skills education for justice\-involved youth.
* Present at conferences on promoting youth mental wellness and resilience.
* Represent P4W at community outreach and tabling events to increase awareness of programs and services.

Program Reporting \& Support

* Track attendance and participation for each session, ensuring timely and accurate data entry.
* Collect youth feedback and support basic program evaluation efforts.
* Share success stories, challenges, and program updates with the Program Manager.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Social Work, Psychology, Sociology, Public Health, Education, or a related field required.

**Experience \& Skills**

* Prior experience working or volunteering with at\-risk youth preferred but not required.
* Strong public speaking and group facilitation skills.
* Experience with basic data collection, tracking, and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Canva.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.

**Additional Requirements** 

* Work schedule consists primarily of afternoon and evening hours based on program and site needs.
* Following hire, employees will be required to successfully complete a background investigation conducted by the Probation Department to obtain and maintain access to assigned program sites.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, proof of automobile insurance, and documentation establishing identity and employment authorization are required.
* Regular travel to juvenile justice sites required; occasional travel to community locations, conferences, and outreach events as needed.
* Mileage reimbursement provided for approved work\-related travel.

**Compensation: $24\-$25 per hour, depending on qualifications and experience.**

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are:
***Why Lucky Strike?***

We Are Lucky Strike Entertainment, one of the largest and most successful location\-based entertainment companies in the World with 360 upscale and traditional Bowling Centers, five expansive and well\-located Waterparks, a large Amusement Park in California and 10 upscale Boomers Family Entertainment Centers in major markets.

From a humble beginning with one bowling center in 1997, we redefined an industry and built a powerhouse Company with 14,000 Associates and nearly $1\.4 billion in annual revenue. Hospitality is our core and we strive to deliver memorable experiences for every guest on every visit.

When you join Lucky Strike, you join a team of passionate winners and give yourself the best opportunity for sustained career growth and opportunity. It’s not easy to get hired by us – we want only the most talented and committed Managers, but when you do join Lucky Strike, the rewards are abundant.  


Overview:

Imagine your ideal job. Now add bowling, arcade games, amazing parties, and delicious food. This isn’t any ordinary office; it’s the beginning of a bowled new career as an **Event Operations Manager.**

  

Our Event Operations Managers know what it means to throw the perfect party. They manage a staff of Event Hosts who work diligently to ensure our event clients and guests are totally satisfied with every aspect of their events. Reporting to the center’s General Manager, the Event Operations Manager is a great opportunity for someone with exceptional organizational skills and amazing people skills to match.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES:** ***Get a glimpse of all you’ll experience as an Event Operations Manager***

 **BE THE HOST WITH THE MOST**

* Host special events; manage your team of event hosts; oversee all setup of appropriate areas

**BRING THE PARTY TO LIFE**

* Working with the Sales staff and Operations team, help create a seamless event experience that results in guests who book with us again and again

**CONNECT WITH YOUR CLIENT**

* Make a personal connection with your event contact and ensure that all of their guests’ needs aren’t just met, but exceeded; consistently promote this guest\-focused approach to hosting

**ALWAYS BE IMPROVING**

* Ensure the completion of all event reporting and use guest feedback reports to continuously improve guest satisfaction

**MANAGE THE TEAM**

* Utilize our client database to forecast events and schedule our event staff appropriately; counsel and discipline staff as required according to HR guidelines and policies

**REMAIN FLEXIBLE**

* Be available to work varying shifts, from weekends to holidays, in addition to extended workdays as needed by your center

 **WHO YOU ARE**


You’re an event professional who knows that the secret to every great party is a room full of satisfied guests. Your guest service radar is finely tuned and you impart that mindset to all of the event hosts whom you manage. You have experience leading a team and knowledge of the hospitality industry and event planning/execution. You’re also a rock\-solid communicator whose interpersonal skills are second to none. And since events aren’t always 9 to 5, you’re flexible to work a variety of shifts, from weekends and holidays to extended workdays. **DESIRED SKILLS:** ***Check out the desired skills below and see if you have what it takes to join our world\-class team***

* 1 Year\+ of Management Experience
* 2\+ Years Banquet Captain
* Bachelor’s degree
* Knowledge of F\&B and Hospitality Industry
* Broad Knowledge of/Experience in Event Planning and Execution
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite and database software preferred
* Knowledge of POS register systems

**WORK ENVIRONMENT/ PHYSICAL DEMANDS**:  

* Typical entertainment environment where you will walk, bend and stand for periods of time, and may lift objects with some assistance.


\#LI‑DNP
Benefits:  

The pay range for this position is $28\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour.  

Lucky Strike Entertainment offers performance\-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package which includes healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. More details regarding benefits are available here: Lucky Strike Entertainment Benefits

At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors  

Solid technical understanding and field sales experience selling power monitoring and control software, associated metering and communications systems, direct current, and battery energy storage/microgrid solutions.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger

jobs.title: Resolution Account Manager
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN TAXRISE?  


At TaxRise, we don't just provide tax relief services; we provide hope, stability, and solutions to individuals and families facing financial uncertainty. Our team is passionate about reshaping the tax resolution industry through innovation, empathy, and unwavering commitment to our clients.  


Join us and make a tangible difference in people's lives while growing your career with a team that values your contributions.  


ABOUT THE ROLE  


The Case Manager III works directly alongside our Enrolled Agents to help move complex and time\-sensitive tax resolution cases toward successful outcomes.  


While our Enrolled Agents focus on developing resolution strategies and negotiating with the IRS and state taxing authorities, the Resolution Account Manager provides critical case support by communicating with clients, obtaining urgent or additional documentation, coordinating next steps, and ensuring the Enrolled Agents have everything needed to effectively advocate for the client.  


This role will frequently support cases requiring additional attention or urgency, including matters involving Revenue Officers and Offer in Compromise (OIC) Examiners. You'll assist with these cases by communicating with the appropriate IRS contacts, tracking requests and deadlines, coordinating required documentation, and keeping the Enrolled Agent informed of important case developments.  


You'll serve as an important connection between the client, the Enrolled Agent, and taxing authorities, helping translate case needs into clear action items and keeping cases moving when timing matters most.  


We're all about that in\-person vibe, so this role is 100% on\-site! If you're excited to work side\-by\-side with our team (or are ready to make the move), then you're a perfect fit. If not, we kindly ask you to hold off on applying. Thanks for understanding and happy job hunting!  


HOW YOU'LL BE REWARDED  


At Tax Rise, Inc., we recognize and reward high performance, ownership, and results.  


Base pay: $24\.00 \- 25\.00 per hour  
Monthly Bonus: Average bonus potential of $1,000 \- $1,500  


Full\-time \| 40 hours per week. Occasional overtime may be required based on business needs.  


WHAT YOU'LL DO  


Enrolled Agents \& Case Support:  


Partner directly with assigned Enrolled Agents to support active tax resolution cases.  
Review case needs and prioritize client outreach based on deadlines, urgency, and direction from the Enrolled Agent.  
Assist with managing priority and time\-sensitive cases, including matters involving Revenue Officers and Offer in Compromise (OIC) Examiners.  
Communicate directly with Revenue Officers and OIC Examiners, as appropriate, to provide requested documentation, obtain case updates, clarify outstanding requirements, and coordinate next steps on behalf of the Enrolled Agent.  
Track IRS requests, deadlines, and follow\-up items to ensure required documentation and information are submitted timely and cases continue moving forward.  
Relay important updates, requests, and deadlines from Revenue Officers and OIC Examiners to the assigned Enrolled Agent and coordinate any necessary client follow\-up.  
Maintain clear documentation of IRS communications and escalate case developments requiring the Enrolled Agent's review, strategy, or negotiation.  


Client Communication:  


Serve as a consistent point of contact for assigned case\-related action items.  
Contact clients by phone, email, or approved communication channels to obtain additional financial and tax documentation requested by the Enrolled Agent, IRS, or state taxing authority.  
Clearly explain what is needed, why it is needed, and applicable deadlines.  
Review incoming documentation and promptly follow up on missing or incomplete information.  


CRM Management \& Case Tracking:  


Maintain detailed and accurate CRM notes documenting client conversations, outstanding items, Enrolled Agent requests, deadlines, and case progress.  
Monitor assigned tasks and follow\-ups to ensure urgent requests are completed within required deadlines.  


WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO HAVE  


Previous experience in document coordination, loan processing, or a similar administrative role (tax\-related experience is a plus).  
Strong ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, and competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.  
Proven experience handling urgent and sensitive client situations while maintaining professionalism and composure.  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex requests in an understandable way.  
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify missing or incomplete documentation.  
Proficiency in using CRM systems or document management tools; familiarity with tax software is a bonus.  
Strong follow\-up skills and the ability to take ownership of assigned tasks through completion.  
Ability to collaborate closely with Enrolled Agents and follow case\-specific directions..  
Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment while meeting deadlines.  
Knowledge of IRS and state tax documentation is a plus; additional training will be provided.  


WHAT WE OFFER  


We believe in taking care of our team so they can take care of our clients. Here's what you can expect as part of the TaxRise family:  


Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (starting after 60 days)  
Paid Time Off  
401(k) retirement plan with company match  
Professional Development Program to support your growth  
Access to our on\-site gym and gaming lounge  
Catered team lunches every Friday  
Fun and energizing quarterly company outings  


ABOUT US  


At TaxRise, our mission is simple yet impactful: to revolutionize the way taxpayers navigate their tax challenges. We believe in the power of lifting others up, and that's the driving force behind everything we do.  


When you join us, you're not just becoming part of a company; you're joining a movement. We'

jobs.description:
**Title:** **Sales Representative \- Uniform**
==============================================

Location: Tustin, CA, US, 92780
  
**Requisition Number:** 236057


**Job Description**
-------------------


Are you ready to launch your career in sales and be another reason Cintas, a growing Fortune 500 company, has been named to both FORTUNE’s World’s Most Admired Companies and Selling Power’s 60 Best Companies to Sell For? We start every day by asking how we can have an even greater impact: safer, cleaner, more efficient, better designed, and more sustainable. Our sensibilities and principles are rooted in always seeking to do better for our customers, for our partners, and for our planet.
  

Join employee\-partners who are recognized for being positive, respectful, motivated, and caring. These characteristics are an important part of our history and culture, and they are at the heart of everything we do.
  

That is why we are seeking a goal\-oriented, motivated, and energetic Sales Representative to join our growing Outside Sales team. This role provides our customers with solutions to their facility services needs by offering industry\-leading products and hands\-on help with the details of their workday. At Cintas, you will be building a successful, rewarding career while supporting our customers as they get Ready for the Workday™. In this business\-to\-business (B2B) sales role, you will apply the learnings from the Cintas Sales Training Program. This includes putting into practice valuable skills in cold\-calling, in\-person sales, product demonstrations, negotiations, objection\-handling, and closing.
  

As an Outside Sales team member, you will be responsible for prospecting, developing, and qualifying leads within your respective territory. You will utilize our CRM to identify, prospect, close new business and consistently achieve weekly sales goals and quotas.
  

What We Offer:
  

* Salary \+ Monthly Commission: Competitive base salary with the potential to earn unlimited commission and a quarterly bonus based on performance.
* Extensive Car Package: A monthly car allowance/reimbursement, insurance, gas, and maintenance on your personal car.
* Hands\-on Training Program \& Certification: Comprehensive training and certification, ensuring you are set up for success.
* Monthly, Quarterly, \& Annual Recognition: Regular recognition, including Summit Events, President’s Club and other awards for your contributions and achievements.
* Limitless Career Advancement \& Mentorship Opportunities: Grow your career with clear paths for promotion and professional development.

A Successful Candidate in This Role:
  

* Will be competitive, self\-motivated, and disciplined; strives to exceed all weekly, quarterly, and annual goals and expectations
* Will be collaborative; a team\-player who celebrates the victories of themselves and their team.
* Will be coachable; has a willingness to learn and an eagerness to take action.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Yowei Therapeutics and Yowei Oncology are stealth\-stage life\-sciences companies working closely with CSBio to advance peptide\-based clinical programs. Their work spans longevity and peptide therapeutics, clinical trials, evaluation of a 503A pharmacy model, personalized synthetic neoantigen peptide oncology programs, and supporting microbiology and laboratory capabilities. Together, they are building the clinical, pharmacy, data, laboratory, and operational infrastructure needed to responsibly translate peptide programs into patient\-facing studies and services. Both companies expect to remain in stealth through Q1 2027\.


CSBio is a peptide contract manufacturing founded in 1993\. CSBio initial products were a complete line of automated synthesizers for manufacturing and process development, with a focus on cGMP production. In 1994, CSBio opened a custom peptide facility and began producing high quality compounds for research organizations and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. In 2004, CSBio opened a peptide production facility in Menlo Park, CA and in 2014, CSBio expanded production capability through the addition of a new, state of the art building dedicated to cGMP peptide production. In 2017, CSBio passed a FDA inspection and were recommended to be approved for commercial drug substance manufacturing. In 2023, additional cGMP clinical production capacity was added in Milpitas, CA.


Yowei Therapeutics is seeking a detail\-oriented Clinical Research Coordinator to manage day\-to\-day study coordination for early clinical and longevity programs. Core duties are included below.


Job Duties:

* Coordinate study startup, participant screening, scheduling, visits, follow\-up, and closeout activities under investigator and protocol oversight.
* Maintain regulatory, delegation, training, screening, enrollment, visit, specimen, investigational\-product, issue, and action logs as assigned.
* Prepare visit packets and confirm consent, eligibility, orders, supplies, equipment, staff, and vendor readiness before each visit.
* Collect and enter accurate study data from approved sources into EDC, CTMS, electronic source, or other controlled systems; resolve queries promptly.
* Coordinate specimens, laboratories, imaging, pharmacy, vendors, couriers, and chain\-of\-custody requirements.
* Track adverse\-event and deviation documentation and escalate medical or safety issues immediately to qualified personnel; do not make independent clinical decisions.
* Support participant communication, reminders, reimbursement documentation, retention, and approved education materials.
* Support monitoring visits, audits, inspections, document requests, and corrective actions.
* Maintain confidentiality, version control, data quality, and complete records; surface risks and missed deadlines early.
* Prepare concise weekly status reports on enrollment, visits, data completeness, deviations, vendor issues, and decisions needed.
* Collect, process, label, store, and coordinate shipment of clinical specimens when appropriately trained, credentialed, and authorized.

  

**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, health, psychology, public health, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 2\+ years of clinical\-research, site\-coordination, patient\-services, or regulated health\-program experience.
* Working knowledge of GCP, informed\-consent documentation, source records, data entry, privacy, and protocol adherence.
* Strong organization, participant communication, documentation, and follow\-through skills.
* Ability to work on site and manage multiple participants, visits, vendors, and deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:

* Phlebotomy experience strongly preferred, including venipuncture, specimen labeling, processing, handling, and chain\-of\-custody documentation. A current California phlebotomy certificate or another credential authorizing venipuncture is required if the coordinator will perform blood draws.
* ACRP or SOCRA certification.
* Experience with early\-phase, oncology, metabolic health, longevity, infusion, decentralized, or investigator\-initiated research.
* Experience with EDC, CTMS, eRegulatory, electronic source, specimen tracking, or participant\-engagement systems.

  

**Benefits**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (Kaiser HMO or BlueShield PPO. Employer pays 85% for Employee and 50% for Employee’s family; Dental: Aetna Dental, Delta Dental, Guardian Dental, MetLife Dental. Vision: VSP and Aetna EyeMed)
* Basic life ($20,000 paid by company) and supplemental life insurance (optional supplemental).
* Disability insurance 50% standard employer paid.
* 401k 10% 1:1 match
* PTO policy. 10 days PTO
* Companywide paid holiday during: Week of July 4, Thanksgiving (2 days), Week of December 25
* Carpool, clean air vehicle, and cell phone reimbursement
* Employee rewards and recognition program
* Company organized social events
* Quarterly sponsored team building activities

jobs.title: Community Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Community Outreach Coordinator**
----------------------------------


Court Appointed Special Advocates (CASA) of San Mateo County offers a unique opportunity for passionate individuals to make a real difference in the lives of children and youth involved in foster care and the juvenile justice system. By joining our dynamic team, volunteers build long\-lasting relationships with young people, serving as both trusted mentors and powerful advocates within the courtroom and beyond. At CASA, we recruit, train, and empower dedicated volunteers to work one\-on\-one with youth, building meaningful relationships that help transform futures. Our volunteers are trusted mentors and powerful advocates in court and beyond, offering much\-needed stability for children facing uncertain times.


CASA’s office is in Redwood City, CA.


#### **Position Overview**



As our **Community Outreach Coordinator**, you'll be the face of our mission, sparking connections with prospective volunteers and community organizations to grow the network of volunteers who change young lives. In this outward\-facing, communications, driven role, you'll design and lead an active recruitment strategy that reaches new volunteers both virtually and in person, often serving as the very first impression someone has of our organization. This dynamic position calls for a confident communicator who's energized by public engagement and community building, with some evening and weekend availability to meet volunteers where they are. If you're passionate about relationship\-building and driven to expand our community of changemakers, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


The ideal candidate is bilingual and biliterate in Spanish and English, with exceptional interpersonal and motivational communication skills. They bring experience creating volunteer recruitment materials, are highly organized and detail\-oriented, particularly with paperwork and scheduling, and are comfortable researching, analyzing, and compiling data. Has sound judgment, collaborates well with team members, and can think on their feet. Genuine passion for the organization's mission (volunteers can sense authenticity). Patience and flexibility, since volunteer availability and commitment levels vary widely. Ability to make people feel valued and see the tangible impact of their time


**Reports to:** Senior Program Manager\-Initiative, Training and Recruitment


**Status:** Full \-time, non\-exempt; 40 hours per week with occasional evening and weekend work required


**Location:** Redwood City, CA\- Hybrid work schedule with two days in the office and occasional travel to off\-site locations for presentations and events.


#### **Duties and Responsibilities**


* Build and maintain volunteer pipeline:
* Develop and implement a comprehensive volunteer recruitment plan to recruit a diverse pool of volunteers to serve as Court Appointed Special Advocates based on waitlist needs and current volunteer pool.
* Coordinate organizational efforts to recruit a diverse pool of volunteers to (1\) provide culturally and linguistically sensitive services to the youth CASA supports and to (2\) ensure that the organization has a volunteer pool with individuals with diverse backgrounds.
* Identify and establish relationships and promote volunteer opportunities with local community organizations, corporations, associations, collaborations, and networks that act as natural volunteer recruitment sources.
* Build ongoing relationships with community organizations, businesses, and schools as recurring volunteer pipelines.
* Schedule and coordinate orientations, this includes ensuring information is updated, current, and correct on website and other public documentation and delivery of information.
* Process volunteer applications including entering and verifying information is accurate and complete for each prospective trainee on agency database, tracking prospective trainee information, and identifying and reporting to the Program Team on any issues regarding candidates.
* Collaborate with the Development Team to develop and produce recruitment and outreach materials, including PowerPoints, flyers, banners, and both digital and hard copy collateral, as well as contribute to broader organizational marketing and awareness materials beyond volunteer recruitment. This includes Spanish\-language versions.
* Partner with the Development and Program teams to create social media content that supports both volunteer recruitment and CASA's broader organizational marketing, awareness, and engagement efforts, coordinating translation support as needed.
* Design or coordinate recruitment campaign materials with design/marketing teams when available, ensuring materials support broader outreach efforts.
* Ensure all recruitment and outreach materials reflect a consistent employer brand voice and messaging, in compliance with EEO/equal opportunity language requirements.
* Identify and engage candidates through volunteer pipelines, LinkedIn, referrals, networking events, and databases, including proactive outreach to passive candidates.
* Present to external audiences to recruit volunteers, raise awareness, engage corporate and community partners, and raise the profile of CASA of San Mateo County.
* Plan and host community events and outreach activities that raise awareness of CASA's mission and create multiple pathways for community involvement.
	+ Special events and projects, as required.
* Develop strategies to improve volunteer pipeline from first contact through long\-term service.
* Research and document current recruitment and retention practices.
* Analyze pipeline data to identify where volunteers drop off and manage a defined schedule of touch points that keeps volunteers engaged and tracked at every stage.
* Use outcome and attrition data to identify the highest\-drop\-off phases, especially application and assignment, and to develop targeted strategies to close those gaps.
