jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator (Evening Shift)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US:** \- We believe that everyone deserves a home!
  
  

Breaking Ground operates nearly 4,000 units of housing across New York City, along with housing in upstate New York and Connecticut. Supportive housing \- affordable housing paired with services designed to help people maintain their homes for the long\-term \- is widely recognized as a proven and cost\-effective solution to chronic homelessness.
  
  

But we didn't stop at providing housing. Breaking Ground's programs and services help people experiencing street homelessness \- especially those who have been on the streets the longest \- to come indoors. Through our Street to Home outreach program and transitional housing resources, we help people get, and stay, on the path to a permanent home.
  
  

Breaking Ground’s Street to Home program makes regular contact with more than 2,000 street homeless individuals and connects more than 500 individuals to housing, medical and mental health services, substance abuse counseling, and other essential supports each year. The caring, individually tailored attention clients receive at each stage of their journey from street to home ensures that more than 95% of people who Breaking Ground places remain stably housed.
  
  

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Programs, Outreach, the Outreach Coordinator manages and supervises street outreach teams, providing coordination across the teams to ensure there is always staff deployed in the field and helps to triage and prioritize urgent requests or developing situations. The Outreach Coordinator ensures the teams utilize Harm Reduction and Housing First approaches when conducting street outreach and engage with individuals to determine homelessness history, services needed, and appropriate placement options from the field in the moment. The Outreach Coordinator creates shift schedules, ensuring continual coverage in the field, and that Housing Advocate teams are compliant with data entry requirements into DHS’ system contractual requirements.
  
  

The Outreach Coordinator is responsible for gaining a holistic understanding of the homeless population and works in collaboration with the community and other partners to implement appropriate housing and service solutions. The Outreach Coordinator manages their teams’ responses to community concerns, oversees Code Red/Blue alerts, identifies new hotspots and encampments, plans weekly canvass schedules for the teams, and oversees all 9\.58 assessments and removals for the shift.
  
  

Programs staff are required to locate and assist street homeless individuals under the most extreme weather conditions. Managers are required to be in the field during Code Reds and Code Blues. Staff must be willing to engage with street homeless individuals and can handle multiple tasks in a fast paced, dynamic, team environment.
  
  

This position is primarily the evening shift and has a 35\-hour work week as well as on\-call responsibilities.
  
  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:**  

Successful oversight and performance management of street outreach teams including Housing Advocates and a Team Leader II who supervises an additional street outreach team and a part time Social Worker
  
  

Provide regular, structured supervision meetings for direct reports
  
  

Responsible for implementing supervisory strategies, and systems of accountability to ensure that staff have adequate support, guidance, and oversight at all times
  
  

Create and implement shift schedules that ensure teams are deployed at all times; find coverage for callouts, vacations, and vacancies
  
  

Ensure canvassing incorporates feedback from the team, community, DHS, historical 311 data, etc
  
  

Promote effective strategies for outreach work, following Housing First, Harm Reduction, Crisis Prevention Institute (CPI), Motivational Interviewing and trauma\-informed care models of practice
  
  

Ensure adherence to program contracts, regulatory requirements, and internal guidelines, ensuring all performance targets and service delivery benchmarks are consistently met
  
  

Responsible for ensuring documentation, reporting, and referrals are accurately completed on time and in compliance with DHS and Breaking Ground requirements
  
  

Provide support and guidance to staff in managing difficult situations and successfully de\-escalating conflict
  
  

Oversee and participate in Code Blue/Red Alerts, providing clinical leadership to the teams when they encounter challenging situations
  
  

Assess and complete 9\.58 involuntary removals to a hospital and ensure all required documentation is accurate and completed on time
  
  

Serve as a liaison with community partners, intergovernmental stakeholders, DHS staff and other community stakeholders to respond to emergent concerns, including 311 calls and encampment engagement
  
  

Develop strong collaborative relationships with external partners and service providers, NYPD, EMS, etc
  
  

Attend onsite meetings with community partners
  
  

Provide on call coverage as needed for the program
  
  

Perform other duties as assigned
  
  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**  

NYS Licensed Masters Social Worker (LMSW) required
  
  

Minimum 3 years supervisory experience required
  
  

Obtain 9\.58 credentialing within first 3 months of hire required
  
  

Understanding of Housing First, client centered motivational interviewing, Harm Reduction models, behavioral and medical health systems
  
  

Experience with crisis intervention, including, risk assessments and incident management
  
  

Excellent communication skills (verbally and written) and ability to work with diverse population
  
  

Superb collaborative skills; ability to work successfully with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders
  
  

Detailed oriented and can manage team tasks
  
  

Excellent scheduling skills
  
  

Valid NY, NJ, CT, or PA driver’s license with a good driving record, as defined b

jobs.title: Print Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**SEEN is looking for a highly organized, detail\-driven Print Production Coordinator to help bring campaigns from approved artwork to the streets.**

This role sits at the center of our print and campaign operations, coordinating artwork, production, delivery, and installation across a high volume of campaigns. You’ll work closely with our sales, operations, production, and installation teams to make sure every campaign is produced accurately, delivered on time, and installed exactly as planned.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who likes moving quickly, keeping details straight, solving problems, and seeing their work physically come to life in the city.

**What You’ll Do**

* Coordinate print campaigns from artwork approval through production, delivery, and installation
* Review campaign specs, quantities, sizes, materials, artwork, and production requirements
* Coordinate with internal production teams, printers, installers, and vendors
* Track production schedules and campaign deadlines across multiple active projects
* Confirm artwork is properly prepared and production\-ready
* Manage print orders and ensure the correct materials and quantities are produced
* Coordinate delivery of printed materials to warehouses, installers, and job sites
* Maintain accurate campaign trackers, production schedules, and status updates
* Communicate campaign updates and potential issues to internal teams
* Identify production or scheduling issues early and help find solutions
* Work closely with installation teams to make sure the right materials arrive at the right location at the right time
* Help manage last\-minute changes, reprints, rush orders, and other real\-world campaign needs
* Keep detailed records of campaign materials, costs, deliveries, and completion
* Support post\-campaign reconciliation and reporting
* Additional duties around billboard installation and or tasks may arise during your employment.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2\+ years of experience in print production, advertising, OOH, media, marketing operations, or a related field
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
* Comfortable managing multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent communication skills and follow\-through
* Comfortable working with printers, production vendors, and internal teams
* Ability to understand print specifications, materials, quantities, and production requirements
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change quickly
* Resourceful problem solver who doesn’t wait around for someone else to fix an issue
* Someone who takes ownership and understands that the details matter

**The SEEN Mindset**

We work in the physical world. Things have to get printed, delivered, installed, and seen.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Open Standard**


Open Standard is on a mission to build the world's best money, starting with the US dollar. We believe money should move the way data does: instantly, globally, at any hour, in any amount. Today, financial transactions are hindered by delays, fees, and inefficiencies that every business must bear. We’re here to change that.


Our flagship product, Open USD, is a stablecoin designed for the internet: programmable, global, and built to reward the businesses that champion its adoption. Launched in close partnership with industry leaders like Stripe, Visa, Mastercard, Coinbase, and Shopify, Open Standard already has over 200 top companies in its network. Our lean team is based in San Francisco and New York and is led by Zach Abrams, who co\-founded Bridge (acquired by Stripe for $1\.1B) and previously led product at Brex, Coinbase, and Square.


Money is the world's most foundational product. Join us to help redefine it.

**Your role**


As Open Standard’s first Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in bringing the world’s largest banks, payment companies, and fintechs onto the Open USD platform. From the day a partner signs, you will become their main point of contact, guiding them through integration, launch, and every stage of future growth. You’ll collaborate closely with product teams at our founding partners, including Stripe, Coinbase, Visa, and Mastercard, whose customers will be among the first to use Open USD.


This is an exciting opportunity to help shape Open Standard’s partner experience, take our earliest partnerships live, and convert a network of signed partners into a community of deeply engaged adopters.

**What you'll do**

* Launch new partners quickly by coordinating across Legal, Product, Compliance, and integration teams, ensuring launches happen in days, not weeks
* Develop tailored growth plans with each partner: define how Open USD fits their business, project transaction volumes for the first year, and identify key success drivers; lead quarterly reviews with partner leadership
* Connect partners within the network to foster collaboration and unlock new value as more companies adopt Open USD
* Serve as the single point of contact for partners after signing: manage launch announcements, handle reporting questions, and involve internal teams (Finance, Legal, Product) as needed
* Own the partner demand picture: build and maintain partner\-level forecasts that guide Liquidity, Finance, and Product planning
* Continuously improve our onboarding and product by turning every partner’s experience into future best practices and enhancements

**You may be a good fit if you**

* Have experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking\-as\-a\-service platform
* Have worked in a network or marketplace business where facilitating participant connections was part of your role
* Possess enough technical fluency to lead integration calls without needing a dedicated solutions engineer

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking\-as\-a\-service platform (if not already mentioned above)
* Additional technical expertise to independently own integration conversations

**Logistics**

* **Location:** San Francisco or New York, hybrid with a mix of in\-office and remote days

**Come work with us**


Open Standard is headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York. We’re a small, senior, and entrepreneurial team with high autonomy and trust. If our mission excites you and you meet most of the qualifications, we want to hear from you.


Compensation Range: $175K \- $210K

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager - NYC
jobs.description:
### **Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

### **The Opportunity**


Are you a results\-driven sales professional with over five years of experience in managing enterprise accounts and a passion for building lasting client relationships? If so, you will thrive in our dynamic remote environment and play a crucial role in driving revenue growth as you collaborate with a dedicated team to deliver exceptional value to our clients in Cincinnati and beyond.### **About the Team**


The Advisory Enterprise Account Manager role will be part of the Sales team at Nutanix, specifically located in the greater NYC area. This dynamic and diverse team is focused on delivering innovative solutions to enterprise clients, fostering a culture of collaboration and high performance. With a mission to empower organizations through cutting\-edge technology, the team emphasizes customer\-centric service, ensuring that clients achieve their business goals through Nutanix's offerings.
You will report to the Director of Sales, who is known for a supportive and empowering leadership style that encourages individual growth and team success. The work setup for this position is remote, providing flexibility for the new hire, with no requirement to go into the office unless desired.
This role includes a required travel commitment of approximately 30%, allowing you to engage with clients and build relationships in various locations, while contributing to the overall success of the team's objectives.### **Your Role**

* Manage a portfolio of enterprise accounts to drive revenue growth and achieve sales targets.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within assigned accounts.
* Identify client needs and align solutions to meet their business objectives.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of products and services.
* Conduct regular business reviews to assess performance, uncover opportunities, and mitigate risks.
* Lead negotiations and close contracts while ensuring compliance with company policies.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activities to inform sales strategy.
* Set and achieve objectives for client satisfaction and revenue growth within the first year.

### **What You Will Bring**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in enterprise account management or related field.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
* Effective problem\-solving and analytical thinking abilities.
* Familiarity with remote sales strategies and tools.
* Adaptability to a fast\-paced and changing environment.
* Understanding of market trends and industry dynamics.

### **Work Arrangement**


Remote: This position is primarily remote. There is no specific in\-office requirement, however, there may be circumstances where you may be required to come into a local office for a specific purpose, and/or to travel to other locations based on business needs.
The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $ 300,000 and USD $ 450,000 per year.
However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign\-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
If hired, employee will be in an “at\-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.

jobs.description:
Discover your next career at Mygrant Glass!  


About Us:  


Mygrant Glass was established in 1926, we've journeyed from a single location in California to becoming the largest independent wholesale distributor of automotive glass in the United States. Our enduring success is built on a foundation of unparalleled inventory, an extensive warehouse network, and uncompromising quality standards. We thrive on forming lasting partnerships that drive the success of our valued customers.  


Account Manager  


Exempt  


Reports To: Regional Sales Director  


Compensation: Pay range for position is $90,000\-$105,000 based on experience.  


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:  


Accurately present the “Mygrant message” to current and prospective customers.  
Participate with management in updating territory plans and setting sales goals.  
Identify emerging markets and market shifts.  
Analyze sales potential for new and existing customers through inquiry, observation or research to grow market share.  
Travel in the respective territory utilizing time and territory management skills to promote Mygrant products and services, identify customer needs, and to develop and improve company's relationship with customers.  
Engage and partner with clients to determine a competitive offering of the company's products and services while implementing company’s sales strategies.  
Interface with clients to pinpoint and overcome potential obstacles such as competition, pain points, budgets, and timelines.  
Communicate closely with Branch Manager and sales team on customer opportunities, status, proposals, and service levels, and make recommendations regarding same.  
Assist customers with special requests and problems (supply information, resolve complaints, etc.).

Continuously update company’s CRM program.

Exceptional team player with organizational astuteness to prioritize, and multi\-task.  
Highly organized and detail\-oriented  
Customer\-facing experience, working with auto parts/auto glass customers is a plus  
Solid organizational \& planning skills with attention to detail

Strong aptitude for consultative selling  
Prior usage of CRM tools  
Solid interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written

jobs.title: Mid-Market Advertising Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Advertising Sales Representative Team Lead/Consultant \| Mid\-Level \| Full time
Job No. R00358773 \| New York City, NY
  
Within Operations, we are expanding our Digital Inside Sales (DIS) organization to accelerate growth in the SaaS, AI and digital solutions space. Our innovative, data\-driven sales model combines trusted technical expertise, cutting\-edge technology, and AI\-powered insights to help clients transform and scale efficiently. We’re looking for a commercially driven and customer\-focused Advertising Sales Account Manager to manage a portfolio of existing customers.

  

The Mid\-Market Advertising Sales Account Manager is responsible for owning and growing a portfolio of advertisers through strategic account planning, consultative selling, disciplined pipeline management, and high\-quality execution. This role combines hands\-on client engagement with broader responsibility for revenue performance, account health, and delivery excellence.


You will operate as a trusted advisor to advertisers, translating business objectives and performance data into clear growth strategies and practical recommendations. Success requires sound commercial judgement, confidence engaging senior stakeholders, strong ownership of complex work, and the ability to influence outcomes in a fast\-paced, metrics\-driven environment.

  

What You Will Be Doing

  

Strategic Account Ownership \& Customer Engagement

* Own a portfolio of advertisers and serve as the primary commercial and strategic point of contact throughout the account lifecycle
* Develop account plans that identify growth opportunities, risks, client objectives, and clear actions to improve revenue, retention, and advertiser value
* Build trusted relationships with client decision\-makers and confidently lead consultative conversations, performance reviews, and recommendations
* Drive proactive outreach through calls, email, and scheduled follow\-ups, balancing activity expectations with the quality and complexity of each opportunity
* Diagnose advertiser needs and recommend tailored advertising products, campaign strategies, and optimization actions aligned with business goals
* Lead complex or sensitive account discussions, resolve issues, and coordinate the appropriate internal support to protect the client relationship
* Identify expansion, cross\-sell, and retention opportunities using performance trends, market context, and commercial insight
* Partner with sales, product, operations, and support teams to deliver a consistent end\-to\-end advertiser experience

  

Pipeline, Forecasting \& Commercial Discipline

* Maintain a structured, accurate, and strategically prioritized pipeline within Salesforce or an equivalent CRM
* Own revenue pacing and forecast quality for assigned accounts, identifying gaps early and developing recovery or acceleration plans
* Apply sound judgement to prioritize opportunities, client needs, and daily activities against commercial impact
* Meet agreed activity, conversion, revenue, retention, and service\-level expectations while maintaining a high standard of customer engagement
* Ensure clear documentation of client objectives, decision criteria, commercial opportunities, risks, commitments, and next steps
* Use account and pipeline data to provide concise updates, surface trends, and recommend actions to leadership
* Independently manage competing priorities and escalate material risks with clear context and proposed solutions

  

Quality, Leadership \& Continuous Improvement

* Set a strong standard for customer interactions across calls, meetings, and written communication
* Ensure all work complies with agreed processes, turnaround times, quality controls, and data and privacy requirements
* Translate recurring client feedback and performance trends into actionable recommendations for leadership and partner teams
* Identify operational inefficiencies, shape practical improvements, and support implementation of more scalable ways of working
* Provide day\-to\-day guidance, peer support, and knowledge sharing to less experienced team members without direct people\-management responsibility
* Support onboarding, calibration, and best\-practice sharing across the team as required
* Represent Accenture professionally and act as a credible, customer\-centric advocate in all internal and external interactions

  
Basic Qualifications

  

* Minimum 4 years of experience in Advertising Sales or Advertising Account Management

  


Preferred Qualifications

  

* Demonstrated ownership of a client portfolio, revenue target, sales pipeline, or account\-growth plan
* Proven ability to lead consultative client conversations, influence decisions, and
* convert data into clear commercial recommendations
* Experience managing complex client needs, competing priorities, and escalations with limited supervision
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including confidence presenting to senior client and internal stakeholders
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability, with the ability to identify trends, assess risk, and recommend action
* High proficiency in CRM usage, pipeline management, forecasting, and accurate account documentation
* Experience in digital advertising, media sales, SaaS, ad technology, or platform\-based environments
* Working knowledge of digital campaign performance, optimization levers, measurement, and advertising industry trends
* Experience with Salesforce and sales engagement, reporting, or business intelligence tools
* Demonstrated experience coaching peers, supporting onboarding, or contributing to team capability development
* Experience operating in a matrixed environment and coordinating across sales, product, operations, and support teams
* Commercially minded, customer\-centric, and focused on measurable outcomes
* Confident operating with autonomy, ambiguity, and accountability
* Resilient and composed when managing challenging conversations or perfor

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Critical Industries
jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors  

Solid technical understanding and field sales experience selling power monitoring and control software, associated metering and communications systems, direct current, and battery energy storage/microgrid solutions.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger

jobs.title: Twitch Account Manager, Twitch
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Ads offers a rich array of advertising solutions to reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, including Twitch, and on other high quality sites across the web. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing organization working to build a unique, world\-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.  

  

The Twitch Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for advertising solutions on Twitch, managing the full advertising funnel from pre\-sale consultation through campaign execution and reporting. This role combines strategic planning, client relationship management, and project management to deliver exceptional advertising experiences on the Twitch platform.  

  

We're looking for a results\-driven Twitch Account Manager who is passionate about creating and executing innovative advertising solutions and building strategic partnerships with brands. As an Account Manager at Twitch, you'll be instrumental in navigating complex advertising challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering measurable results that exceed client expectations.  

  

You'll own end\-to\-end client relationships, leveraging Twitch's unique platform insights to develop and execute customized advertising strategies that drive revenue. You'll work collaboratively across multiple teams including Sales, Product, and Brand Partnerships to develop and execute RFPs and proactive proposals. As the main point of contact both internally and with customers, you'll oversee projects from ideation through final execution.  

  

This highly dynamic role requires someone who can balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, managing the full advertising funnel from pre\-sale consultation through campaign delivery and analysis. Your digital marketing expertise and ability to navigate the unique landscape of live\-streaming content will be crucial in delivering value to our advertisers and contributing to Twitch's continued growth in the advertising space.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Drive Twitch advertising solutions by providing comprehensive pre\-IO support and consultation in partnership with Twitch Account Executive
* Develop and present strategic proposals with Twitch ad product recommendations
* Forecast inventory and develop targeting strategy recommendations
* Create compelling KOC decks featuring concepts, influencer recommendations, and production timelines
* Lead communication between clients and internal teams to finalize campaign concepts
* Generate new business opportunities in partnership with Twitch Account Executives
* Manage creator sponsorships and Twitch promotional products
* Provide real\-time campaign troubleshooting and optimization
* Ensure compliance with advertiser's brand safety requirements
* Evaluate KPIs and optimize campaign delivery and performance using a data driven approach
* Deliver campaign performance reports and conduct wrap\-up calls with clients
* Drive incremental revenue and increase advertiser satisfaction
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C\-level executives and cross\-functional teams
* Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
* Experience in a customer\-facing role, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies
* Experience leading process improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 7\+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, business or equivalent
* Experience meeting quotas and growing revenue
* Experience managing brand intergrations in live envionments

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Chase is a leader in banking, credit card and wealth management services, helping nearly one out of every two American households make the most of their money.


As an Executive Ambassador Programs Operations Associate within Consumer and Community Banking you will help senior leaders build their public profiles through social thought leadership, advancing the firm's strategy and culture. The role supports a high\-profile roster of Consumer \& Community Banking executives and partners closely with executive communicators, content teams, legal and external communications to ensure program execution is timely and compliant. Reporting to the Vice President, Executive Ambassador Program Lead, the Executive Ambassador Program Operations Associate serves as the operational backbone of the program, managing key workflows, anticipating issues, maintaining accurate records and providing high\-quality support in a fast\-paced executive communications environment.




**Job responsibilities**


* Manage recurring program workflows, calendars, trackers and status updates across the executive cohort, maintain onboarding and offboarding materials, permission forms, access records, executive lists and communicator preferences and coordinate onboarding logistics and support smooth transitions when executives or communicators join, leave or change roles
* Maintain and update playbooks, templates, process documentation and training materials, coordinate weekly content batches, previews, reviews, edits, executive approvals and scheduling and manage end\-to\-end publishing in Sprinklr, including quality checks, status tracking and closed\-loop communication with executive communicators.
* Apply LinkedIn best practices and program standards while flagging content that requires strategic, legal or leadership review and maintain legal approval logs and audit evidence when legal review is required
* Support daily monitoring of executive posts and comments during established coverage hours, draft recommended responses and reactions for executive communicator review, reflecting the executive's preferences and voice and coordinate timely follow\-up with executive communicators and escalate customer complaints, sensitive comments or time\-critical issues through the appropriate process.
* Maintain records, escalation documentation and executive preference guidance, maintain audit\-ready records of approvals, publishing activity, monitoring and escalations; Produce accurate monthly, quarterly and year\-to\-date reporting on publishing, reach, engagement, follower growth and participation
* Conduct quality checks, identify data issues and coordinate resolution with platform or reporting partners; Turn performance data into practical recommendations for content, cadence and executive engagement, support procedure updates, control testing, evidence collection and recertification activities and follow applicable social media, legal, privacy and records\-management requirements.
* Build trusted working relationships with executive communicators, social and content teams, PR, video, paid media, controls and legal partners, escalate process gaps, unclear ownership or potential risks promptly and communicate priorities, deadlines, dependencies and status clearly.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort and improve service quality.
* Support trainings, office hours, program meetings and ad hoc initiatives as needed.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**


* 3\+ years of relevant experience in social media operations, employee advocacy, executive communications, program management or a related field.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple high\-priority workflows independently.
* Strong writing, editing and stakeholder communication skills.
* Experience with social media publishing, monitoring and analytics tools, including Sprinklr and LinkedIn analytics.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel, including reporting and data quality review.
* Proven ability to build credibility with senior executives and executive\-level stakeholders, exercising sound judgment, discretion, attention to detail and professionalism when handling sensitive information.
* Ability to follow defined controls while recognizing when a situation requires escalation.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Experience in financial services or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of legal, compliance and records\-management requirements for social media.
* Experience supporting executive social media or thought leadership programs.
* Basic design or multimedia skills in Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.


We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission\-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on\-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

### **Position**

Louis Vuitton is seeking a Digital Marketing Insights Intern to join our Digital team based in New York City. As a Digital Marketing Insights Intern, to join our dynamic Digital team in New York City. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Digital Insights, the intern will play a key role in developing and implementing innovative performance reporting tools for the Digital Marketing team. This exciting opportunity involves supporting the analysis of our SEM, SEO, Email, App, and SMS performance.


### **Job responsibilities**

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:


* Contribute to the development, implementation, and training of new digital marketing reporting tools, supporting our teams as needs arise.
* Assist in preparing regular performance reports and updates for both local and central teams, and help with ad\-hoc performance analyses, integrating both quantitative and qualitative insights.
* Support the Digital Marketing Director by providing data\-driven insights and recommendations to enhance our marketing strategy.
* Provide valuable assistance in preparing strategic presentations, including weekly, monthly, and quarterly updates.
### **Profile**

We are excited to speak to individuals who are eager to develop their analytical and data interpretation skills. The ideal candidate will be a resourceful problem\-solver with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. We value individuals with strong interpersonal skills who are collaborative and possess a keen attention to detail.


While not strictly required, a foundational understanding of digital marketing (SEM, SEO, CRM) or data/e\-commerce analytics would be beneficial. Familiarity with Excel, including functions, formulas, and pivot tables, is a plus, as is any exposure to GA4 or Looker Studio. Experience with data visualization tools like PowerBI is also advantageous. We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate a passion for our industry and an eagerness to learn.  



**Compensation**

* Undergraduate Interns will be compensated at: $20/hour
Graduate Interns will be compensated at $25/hour  
* 

**Criteria**

* Currently enrolled undergraduate/graduate student pursuing a degree in a related field of study
* Able and willing to work at assigned location or able and willing to relocate to NYC
* We welcome candidates that can commit to a **full\-time basis for up to 37\.5 hours per week from October 2026 to April 2027\.**

Louis Vuitton is a company that respects the uniqueness of each employee and offers everyone the means to find their place and prosper. Founded in Paris in 1854, Louis Vuitton perpetuates the ambitious vision of its namesake. **Recruiter:** Marcus Gipson

  

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.


We're looking for a motivated and driven **Business Development Representative** who will be responsible for leading, managing and strengthening relationships with our bus operator partners, ensuring long\-term success, and identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion. The Business Development Representative will also be responsible for sourcing new partners to work with Flix.


This role demands a strategic thinker with a proven track record in business development, adept at navigating complex negotiations and fostering long\-term relationships.


**About the Role**


* Manage and nurture relationships with existing partners, ensuring mutual growth and profitability
* Identify and secure new partnerships with intercity bus operators and other relevant stakeholders to expand Flix's presence in the US East region
* Conduct thorough market research to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive landscapes, informing strategic decisions
* Work closely with internal teams, including Network Planning, Operations, Finance, and Marketing, to ensure cohesive strategy execution
* Develop processes and coordinate a variety of projects, making sure the interactions between departments are fluid and results are delivered in a timely manner
* Analyze and optimize partner performance using data\-driven insights, collaborating with internal teams to adjust network strategy and maximize profitability
* Serve as a Flix ambassador at industry events, conferences, and meetings, enhancing brand visibility and credibility

**About You**


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Communications or a related field
* 3\-5 years of experience in an externally facing role (business development, sales, account management, consulting or strategic roles)
* Full of ambition, not afraid of rapid change, and able to deal with ambiguity
* Strong analytical abilities, strong negotiation skills, excellent communication skills, proficiency in data\-driven decision\-making and capable of building strong relationships with various types of companies and stakeholders
* Entrepreneurial mindset, self\-motivated, and capable of working autonomously to achieve ambitious targets
* Willingness to travel, up to 20% of time

*Salary Range: $85,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00* *USD*


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!


**What We Offer**


* **Comprehensive Wellness Coverage**\- Competitive Medical, Vision, and Dental plans, including multiple FSAs (Health and Dependent Care).
* **401(k) Matching**– 401(k) plan with up to 4% company matching contributions.
* **Flexible Time Off**\- Take time off when you need it, as you need it, subject to business needs and manager approval.
* **Paid Parental Leave**\- 8 weeks of fully paid leave to support new parents and growing families.
* **Company Paid Life Insurance**– Basic company\-paid life insurance equal to your annual salary.
* **Lifestyle Spending Account** – Receive up to $600 per year for eligible lifestyle\-related services.
* **Tuition Support**\- Up to $5,250 per year reimbursed for your continued education and development after 12 months of continuous service.
* **24/7 Employee Assistance Program**\- Free, confidential support for mental health, legal, financial, and family issues, including up to 5 free counseling sessions per year.
* **Free Travel Perks**– Complimentary travel on FlixBus and Greyhound for you, family, and friends.
* **Work from (M)Anywhere** \- Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location,


**Why Join Flix?**


At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
  

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.


If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

Are you curious and want to shoot for the stars, open to giving and receiving feedback, hungry for empowerment and always taking a hands\-on approach? Well then we want to chat. quantilope automates consumer research to unlock high quality insights with speed \& ease. * Research your own book of business in order to expand quantilope’s footprint
* Be an active participant in team trainings and certification programs
* Schedule qualified meetings for Account Executives on the sales team
* Data management and reporting in our CRM system

* Someone with strong communication skills
* You are persistent and resilient in the face of adversity
* Have exceptional active listening skills
* Self\-motivated and goal\-oriented
* A fast learner and can quickly adapt to changes
* A strong team player that lifts up others around them through their work and actions
**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* **Industry knowledge (Market Research) or Previous Sales Experience:** While it is not mandatory for you to have extensive market research knowledge or experience, it can be a valuable asset. Having familiarity with the industry or the specific product/service being sold allows the candidate to quickly understand customer needs, ask relevant questions, and engage in more meaningful conversations with potential leads.
* **Technical aptitude:** While not mandatory, having a good level of technical aptitude can be advantageous for an SDR at quantilope. It will enable you to quickly understand and effectively communicate the technical aspects of the product. This trait can be particularly beneficial when engaging with leads from the Market Research space, as it helps establish credibility and provide accurate information during the sales process.
**Benefits of working at quantilope:**
--------------------------------------

Flexible work environment: With flexible PTO, flexible working hours and remote/hybrid opportunities, we believe you can succeed from anywhere. Did we mention that everyone has the opportunity to work abroad for up to 6 weeks per year?  

* 

Ongoing learning: With our dedicated learning budget for every employee and company\-wide workshops with the best in the biz, we believe in providing our employees with all the tools they need to excel.  
* 

Wellness is key: We offer full benefits (health, dental, and vision) as well as the support of certified mental health first aiders. We also have Quantiwell days which are global mental health days twice a year where the whole company takes a day for themselves.  
* 
* Diverse \& inclusive community: Our team spans the globe, driving diverse ways of working and thinking. With the help of an incredible Community Committee, we are committed to advancing education and awareness.

Planning for the future: At quantilope, we keep your financial wellness top of mind with a 401k program and a 3\.5% annual match.  
* 
* Team bonding: Team offsites, summer and holiday parties.. .where in the world will we bring the team together next? We’re all working hard and know how important it is to have fun along the way.

  

Compensation: $67k base salary \+ Commission ($87k OTE)  

  

\#LI\-Hybrid
  
**Über uns**
------------


Meet quantilope: Great people, innovative technology, and the foundation to create an impact. quantilope automates consumer research with AI\-driven solutions to support data\-driven decision making. Founded in 2014, we're recognized for our innovation and rapid growth. quantilope provide insights in brand awareness, market segmentation, advertising testing, product concepts, pricing analysis, and more for 300\+ brands.  

  

As a consumer research technology company, we know the importance of diversity not only in our data but also across our team. At quantilope, we celebrate and welcome all people regardless of their gender identity, age, sexual orientation, race, religion, or ethnicity. We strongly believe that best ideas come from sharing and collaborating across diverse perspectives and experiences.  

  

Join us and let's see what we can build together!

jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Location:
Atlanta, GA, US, 30339  

  

**Best People \+ Right Culture. These are the driving forces behind JE Dunn’s success.**


**By hiring inspired people, giving them interesting and challenging work, enabling them with innovative tools, and letting them share in the company’s rewards, we’ve found a sustainable way to grow in our industry for the last 100\+ years.**


**Our diverse teams around the country strive to enrich lives through inspired people and places everyday, and we need inspired people like you to join us in building authentic partnerships.**


**Role Summary**
----------------


The Project Coordinator will provide routine administrative support to internal and external project management team members. This position will collect, process, input, organize and file data and documentation from various sources and stakeholders in order to support the administrative, documentation, data, reporting, compliance and communications needs of projects. All activities will be performed in support of the strategy, vision and values of JE Dunn.


* Autonomy \& Decision Making: Follows directions and refers all exceptions to supervisor.
* Career Path: Senior Project Coordinator
**Key Role Responsibilities \- Core**
-------------------------------------


*PROJECT COORDINATOR – CORE*
  

* Utilizes responsibility matrix (WorkSmart) to ensure alignment with ongoing business process improvement efforts, supporting full project lifecycle.
* Collects, processes, inputs, organizes and files data and documentation from various sources and stakeholders as requested by project management team in accordance with established business processes.
* Processes information within specific timeframes in order to maintain efficiency and timeliness.
* Provides timely and effective communication to internal and external stakeholders.
* Supports project management during the bidding process, with deliverables such as creating bid invitations, preparing specifications documents, addressing regulatory and compliance requirements and creating, tracking and following up on bid communications.
* Supports project management during the award process by;

o Issuing and/or preparing bond memos
  

o Setting up, issuing, and fully executing subcontracts
  

o System access to dashboards
  

* Organizes information into standard formats and reports in various systems and locations such as the project dashboard, CMiC, electronic signature tools, etc. Maintains documents per established file structure.
* Coordinates submission of project documentation per project requirements. Prepares routine correspondence (such as letters, emails, meeting notes and proposals) and reviews outgoing materials for conformance with best practice standards and formats.
* Creates and distributes potential change items (PCIs) and requests for information (RFIs). Follows up as needed to include pricing efforts and distribution of change orders.
* Supports project management with project deliverables, such as managing information on the project dashboard and electronically processing various documents (such as submittals, pay applications, bills of sale, compliance documentation, requests for information and change documents).
* Tracks, monitors and/or collaborates with internal stakeholders to ensure necessary documentation (such as badging, certified payroll, diversity reporting, insurance certificates, bonds, lien waivers, affidavits, etc.) meets compliance requirements before releasing payments to subcontractors.
* May receive and direct incoming telephone calls and visitors or provide additional administrative support to other functions to help meet business and staffing needs.
* Shares subject matter expertise to support teamwork and deliver results.
* Utilizes discretion and integrity with highly confidential and sensitive information.
* Demonstrates commitment to the highest standards of customer satisfaction by displaying courtesy and sensitivity and responding promptly to customer needs.
* Manages difficult or emotional customer situations promptly and efficiently.
* Meets client commitments; recognizes and acts upon service opportunities.
* Solicits and applies feedback to improve quality and service.
* May support various administrative needs for the project team as needed, such as arranging team member travel, managing expense reporting, etc.
**Key Role Responsibilities \- Additional Core**
------------------------------------------------


N/A


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
----------------------------------


* Ability to perform work accurately and completely, and in a timely manner
* Communication skills, verbal and written
* Proficiency in MS Office
* Organizational skills
* Ability to work collaboratively and cross\-functionally to obtain information or solve problems in support of the team’s goals
* Critical thinking ability
* Ability to deliver quality through attention to detail
* Ability to learn and use a variety of software, tools and systems necessary to meet business needs
* Knowledge of administrative, office and general billing procedures
* Ability to build relationships and collaborate within a team, internally and externally
**Education**
-------------


High School Diploma or GED (Required).


**Experience**
--------------


* 2\+ years administrative or clerical support experience (Required)
* 2\+ years construction project support experience (Preferred)
**Working Environment**
-----------------------


* Must be able to lift up to 10 pounds
* May require periods of travel
* Must be willing to work non\-traditional hours to meet project needs
* Normal office environment, but may be exposed to extreme conditions (hot or cold)
* Frequent activity: Sitting, Viewing Computer Screen
* Occasional activity: Standing, Walking, Bending, Climbing, Reaching above Shoulder, Pushing, Pulling
**Benefits Information**
------------------------


The benefits package aligned to this position is Professional Non\-Unio

jobs.title: Part-Time Educational Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Are you passionate about working with young children and making a difference through sports? Do you have high energy, patience, and love teaching movement and teamwork? If so, we want you to join our Playball coaching team!**

**About Playball:** Playball is an internationally recognized sports and movement program that introduces young children to the **fundamentals of sports** in a fun, engaging, and structured environment. Through our curriculum, kids build confidence, coordination, teamwork, and a love for active play!

**Job Overview:** We are looking for a **dedicated and energetic Playball Coach and program coordinator** to lead classes in **Forsyth County, GA** **area** for children. Using Playball’s structured lesson plans and creative play\-based games, you will help kids **develop motor skills, improve coordination, and build confidence** while having a blast! In addition, as the educational program coordinator, you will monitor curriculum implementation at each location.

**Position Details:**

* **Hours:** **5\-15 hours per week** (Flexible, based on class schedules)
* **Schedule:** Weekday mornings and/or afternoons with possible weekend opportunities
* **Compensation:** Competitive hourly pay (based on experience)
* Looking for someone established looking to fill in a few other hours. We are **NOT** looking for a student or someone looking to add hours between classes.
* Looking for someone to come to our staff and stay for more than a year. Minimum of 18 month commitment required.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Lead fun, structured sports classes for children ages **2\-8**.

Teach **fundamentals of soccer, basketball, tennis, baseball, and more** through Playball’s curriculum.

Create a **positive, energetic, and inclusive learning environment**.

Encourage **teamwork, participation, and skill\-building** through engaging play\-based activities.

Manage small groups of children while ensuring their **safety and enjoyment**.

Communicate **positively with parents, schools, and fellow coaches**.

Set up and clean up equipment before and after classes.

Visit class locations and monitor curriculum implementation.

**Requirements:**

* Experience working with children (sports coaching, teaching, childcare, or similar roles preferred).
* Must be available **5\-10 hours per week** (flexible scheduling available).
* Must pass a background check.
* Reliable transportation to class locations.
* Willingness to learn and follow Playball’s structured curriculum.
* **Minimum of 18 month commitment required.**

If you’re excited about **teaching young kids, playing games, and making an impact through sports**, we’d love to hear from you!

Job Type: Part\-time

Pay: $24\.00 \- $26\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
PROGRAM COORDINATOR

**Smart from the Start**  
**Location:** Atlanta, GA \| Southwest Atlanta  
**Position:** Full\-Time  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, with some evenings and weekends required  
**Travel:** Local/corporate travel as needed  
**Reports To:** Program Manager  
**Compensation:** Starting salary commensurate with experience

**ABOUT SMART FROM THE START**

Smart from the Start is a family support, community engagement, and school readiness organization committed to strengthening children, families, and communities. We work alongside families to provide the resources, relationships, and opportunities they need to thrive while helping create stronger pathways to school readiness, family stability, and long\-term success.

Our work is rooted in the belief that families already possess strengths, knowledge, and resilience. Our role is to meet families where they are, build trust, connect them to resources, and create meaningful opportunities for children and caregivers to learn, grow, and connect.

Smart from the Start serves families across Boston, Atlanta, Washington, DC, and Philadelphia through our **“Four Cities, One Family”** approach.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Smart from the Start is seeking a **Program Coordinator** to join our Atlanta team and help lead site\-based programming, family engagement, case management, and community outreach efforts in Southwest Atlanta.

This is a highly community\-facing position for someone who enjoys working directly with children and families, building relationships, creating engaging programming, connecting families to resources, managing family support needs, and being part of the day\-to\-day work that makes a community program successful.

The Program Coordinator will work closely with the Program Manager and Smart staff to facilitate programming, provide case management and family support, strengthen community partnerships, engage families, support outreach efforts, maintain accurate participant records, and ensure programs are organized, welcoming, and responsive to the needs of the community.

The ideal candidate is someone who can walk into a room, connect with families, build relationships with community partners, roll up their sleeves when needed, and help turn an idea into a successful program or event.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Program Leadership \& Facilitation

*Facilitates and leads Early Childhood and caregiver programming while providing support to youth development activities and broader family programming as needed.*

* Facilitate Smart from the Start core programming at designated Atlanta program sites.
* Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of family and child\-focused programming.
* Provide direct services, education, support, and resources to children and families.
* Create welcoming and engaging environments that encourage families to participate and remain connected to Smart.
* Support family\-centered events, workshops, community activities, and special initiatives.
* Participate in staff meetings, trainings, planning sessions, and other organizational activities.

Case Management \& Family Support

* Provide ongoing case management and family support to assigned participants.
* Complete family intake, needs assessments, goal setting, service planning, referrals, and follow\-up.
* Work with families to identify strengths, needs, barriers, and goals.
* Develop individualized support plans in collaboration with families.
* Connect families to appropriate community resources, including housing, food assistance, education, employment, childcare, healthcare, behavioral health, transportation, and other supportive services.
* Make referrals and follow up with families and service providers to support successful connections to services.
* Maintain appropriate and timely case notes, referral documentation, and participant records.
* Monitor family engagement and progress toward identified goals.
* Collaborate with Smart staff, community partners, schools, and service providers when additional support or coordination is needed.
* Respond appropriately to family crises and connect families to appropriate crisis intervention and stabilization resources.
* Maintain professional boundaries and protect participant confidentiality.

Family Engagement \& Outreach

* Develop and implement outreach strategies to increase awareness and participation in Smart programming and services.
* Build trusting relationships with parents, caregivers, children, residents, and community members.
* Maintain consistent communication with families and encourage continued participation.
* Conduct community outreach through events, meetings, flyers, partnerships, door\-to\-door engagement, and other strategies.
* Identify barriers that may prevent families from participating and work with the Smart team to develop solutions.
* Support participant retention and engagement throughout the program year.

Database \& Data Management

* Enter, update, and maintain accurate participant and family information in Smart's database and electronic data systems.
* Ensure participant demographic information, program enrollment, attendance, services, referrals, case notes, and other required information are entered accurately and in a timely manner.
* Regularly review database records for missing, incomplete, or inaccurate information and make necessary corrections.
* Maintain accurate documentation to support program reporting, evaluation, funding requirements, and organizational outcomes.
* Track participant engagement, service delivery, referrals, and program participation.
* Assist with generating program reports and collecting data needed to measure program outcomes.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow organizational policies regarding participant information and data security.
* Participate in database training and support ongoing improvements to data quality and documentation practices.
* Work collaboratively with Smart staff to en

Position Information
**Job Type** Non\-Faculty
  

**Position Title** Program Coordinator\-PHSI
  

**Position Number** E00283
  

**Department** Public Health Science Office
  

**Location** Morehouse College \- Atlanta, GA
  

**Position Summary**
The Project Coordinator (PC) supports the Program Director/Program Manager by
performing administrative duties related to planning, directing, and coordinating both
the academic and operational activities of the Public Health Sciences Institute (PHSI)
Programs. These programs include the Lewis Scholars Imhotep (LSI) Project, Innovation* Science, Technology, Engineering, \& Mathematics (iSTEM), and other programs that


support the Institute. Coordinating and monitoring activities and providing
information, recommendations and/or direction as requested by team lead.
  

**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor’s or higher degree, one to two years of experience in an office
environment. Dependable, team player, and demonstrates discretion, take
initiative, good judgement and have positive customer service skills.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting academic, public health, or student success programs, particularly with diverse or underrepresented student populations.
* Coursework, training, or demonstrated exposure to public health, health sciences, or related fields.
* Familiarity with data tracking, reporting, and program evaluation tools (e.g., Excel, survey platforms, or database systems).
* Experience with program coordination, event planning, and managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Experience with digital communications, outreach, or program promotion is a plus.

  

**Preferred Education/Experience**
  

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
* Demonstrates strong communication and interpersonal skills in engaging with students, faculty, mentors, and external partners. Proficient in digital communication platforms, professional email etiquette, and collaborative tools. Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), data management systems, and web\-based platforms (e.g., Formstack, CRM/database systems). Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment where urgent tasks may arise.
* Utilizes technology to support program operations, including data collection, tracking, and reporting aligned with public health program evaluation and outcomes. Familiarity with survey tools, data analytics, and student information systems to support evidence\-based decision\-making and continuous program improvement.
* Builds and maintains strategic relationships and networks across academic, community, and public health sectors to support program visibility, student opportunities, and pipeline development. Stays informed of emerging trends in public health, workforce development, and educational programming.
* Willingness to travel, as needed, to support program initiatives, conferences, workshops, and partnership development opportunities.

  

**Physical Demands**
  

Essential Duties/Responsibilities
**Essential Duties/Responsiblities**
* Provide coordination and operational support for day\-to\-day program and project activities, ensuring alignment with program goals, timelines, and strategic priorities.
* Serve as a primary liaison for students, supporting engagement, success, and retention by clearly communicating program expectations, policies, and available resources.
* Develop and manage program communications and documentation (e.g., correspondence, schedules, applications, reports) in alignment with institutional standards and compliance requirements.
