Development Associate & Events Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Chief Advancement Officer

**Works closely with:** Advancement Team, Database Manager, Admissions, Communications \& Marketing, School Leadership, Business Office, Facilities, faculty, staff, and parent volunteers

**Position Type:** Full\-Time, In\-Person

**Position Overview** 

Tessellations School is seeking a highly organized, collaborative, and service\-oriented Development Associate \& Events Coordinator to support the school’s fundraising, donor engagement, events, organizational planning, and community\-building efforts.

Reporting to the Chief Advancement Officer, this position leads the planning and execution of Development events and supports selected school\-wide events. The role also prepares and distributes fundraising appeals and donor communications; supports gift processing, stewardship, donor research, and accurate data entry; and contributes to the effective operation of the Development program.

The successful candidate will be an enthusiastic builder who can quickly integrate into a fast\-paced school environment, take ownership of projects, anticipate needs, and manage shifting priorities with accuracy and strong follow\-through. As a member of the Advancement team, this position may provide additional operational support across Advancement during high\-volume periods, as assigned by the Chief Advancement Officer.

The position collaborates with Communications \& Marketing for brand and design alignment but is not responsible for general school communications, social media management, or broader marketing initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities** 

**Event Communications, Planning \& Coordination** 

● Lead the planning and execution of Development events, including fundraising, donor research and cultivation, stewardship, and community engagement events. ● Support selected school\-wide events, including Town Halls, Back\-to\-School Night, Curriculum Night, performances, and community gatherings.

● Develop event timelines, budgets, planning checklists, volunteer assignments, operational plans, and run\-of\-show documents.

● Coordinate internal teams and external vendors regarding scheduling, venue setup, technology, catering, equipment, signage, décor, accessibility, and event materials. ● Manage registration, invitations, RSVP lists, attendance tracking, guest information, reminders, and follow\-up communications.

● Recruit, train, schedule, and coordinate parent and community volunteers for assigned events.

● Serve as the primary operational contact for assigned Development events and provide on\-site coordination for Tier 1 and other assigned events.

● Monitor event expenses, invoices, contracts, deposits, and vendor documentation in partnership with the Chief Advancement Officer and Business Office.

● Ensure events are welcoming, organized, mission\-aligned, and consistent with Tessellations’ brand and standards.

● Complete post\-event reporting, reconciliation, documentation, and evaluation to improve future events.

● Event responsibilities will be assigned by the Chief Advancement Officer in collaboration with the department leading each event.

**Development Communications \& Appeals** 

● Prepare and distribute Development communications to parents, donors, volunteers, and other constituent groups.

● Support the creation of Tessie Annual Fund and campaign appeals, donor thank\-you letters, gift acknowledgments, pledge reminders, stewardship updates, event invitations, and follow\-up communications.

● Translate fundraising and engagement priorities established by the Chief Advancement Officer into clear, compelling, and mission\-aligned messaging.

● Personalize communications based on donor or family engagement, giving history, campaign participation, and audience segment.

● Coordinate with the Database Manager to obtain accurate recipient lists and confirm audience segmentation.

● Format, proofread, test, schedule, and send Development emails using the school’s approved communications platforms.

● Coordinate the printing and mailing of appeals, letters, invitations, acknowledgments, and other Development materials.

● Maintain a Development communications calendar and track deadlines, approvals, recipient lists, and distribution schedules.

● Coordinate with Communications \& Marketing when brand assets, templates, photography, design support, or school\-wide alignment are needed.

● Track basic engagement results, including email delivery, open rates, click\-through rates, responses, registrations, and giving activity.

**Gift Processing \& Donor Stewardship** 

● Process gifts, pledges, matching gifts, payments, sponsorships, and in\-kind contributions accurately and promptly.

● Ensure contributions are properly documented and assigned to the correct campaign, fund, appeal, and donor record.

● Prepare personalized gift acknowledgments, tax receipts, pledge reminders, and stewardship communications.

● Support routine gift reconciliation with the Business Office and Database Manager and assist in resolving discrepancies.

● Track Annual Fund, endowment, campaign, sponsorship, and event\-related contributions using established systems and reports.

● Support donor stewardship, recognition, and personalized follow\-up activities. ● Maintain appropriate gift documentation and handle donor and financial information with confidentiality and discretion.

**Donor Research \& Profile Development** 

● Research current and prospective donors using publicly available information and approved research tools.

● Prepare and maintain donor and prospect profiles, including philanthropic interests, giving history, engagement, relationships, and relevant background information.

● Develop concise briefing materials for donor cultivation, solicitation, stewardship, meetings, and visits.

● Assist the Chief Advancement Officer with identifying and qualifying prospective donors, sponsors, community partners, and engagement opportunities.

● Recor

new_jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Yowei Therapeutics and Yowei Oncology are stealth\-stage life\-sciences companies working closely with CSBio to advance peptide\-based clinical programs. Their work spans longevity and peptide therapeutics, clinical trials, evaluation of a 503A pharmacy model, personalized synthetic neoantigen peptide oncology programs, and supporting microbiology and laboratory capabilities. Together, they are building the clinical, pharmacy, data, laboratory, and operational infrastructure needed to responsibly translate peptide programs into patient\-facing studies and services. Both companies expect to remain in stealth through Q1 2027\.


CSBio is a peptide contract manufacturing founded in 1993\. CSBio initial products were a complete line of automated synthesizers for manufacturing and process development, with a focus on cGMP production. In 1994, CSBio opened a custom peptide facility and began producing high quality compounds for research organizations and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. In 2004, CSBio opened a peptide production facility in Menlo Park, CA and in 2014, CSBio expanded production capability through the addition of a new, state of the art building dedicated to cGMP peptide production. In 2017, CSBio passed a FDA inspection and were recommended to be approved for commercial drug substance manufacturing. In 2023, additional cGMP clinical production capacity was added in Milpitas, CA.


Yowei Therapeutics is seeking a detail\-oriented Clinical Research Coordinator to manage day\-to\-day study coordination for early clinical and longevity programs. Core duties are included below.


Job Duties:

* Coordinate study startup, participant screening, scheduling, visits, follow\-up, and closeout activities under investigator and protocol oversight.
* Maintain regulatory, delegation, training, screening, enrollment, visit, specimen, investigational\-product, issue, and action logs as assigned.
* Prepare visit packets and confirm consent, eligibility, orders, supplies, equipment, staff, and vendor readiness before each visit.
* Collect and enter accurate study data from approved sources into EDC, CTMS, electronic source, or other controlled systems; resolve queries promptly.
* Coordinate specimens, laboratories, imaging, pharmacy, vendors, couriers, and chain\-of\-custody requirements.
* Track adverse\-event and deviation documentation and escalate medical or safety issues immediately to qualified personnel; do not make independent clinical decisions.
* Support participant communication, reminders, reimbursement documentation, retention, and approved education materials.
* Support monitoring visits, audits, inspections, document requests, and corrective actions.
* Maintain confidentiality, version control, data quality, and complete records; surface risks and missed deadlines early.
* Prepare concise weekly status reports on enrollment, visits, data completeness, deviations, vendor issues, and decisions needed.
* Collect, process, label, store, and coordinate shipment of clinical specimens when appropriately trained, credentialed, and authorized.

  

**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, health, psychology, public health, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 2\+ years of clinical\-research, site\-coordination, patient\-services, or regulated health\-program experience.
* Working knowledge of GCP, informed\-consent documentation, source records, data entry, privacy, and protocol adherence.
* Strong organization, participant communication, documentation, and follow\-through skills.
* Ability to work on site and manage multiple participants, visits, vendors, and deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:

* Phlebotomy experience strongly preferred, including venipuncture, specimen labeling, processing, handling, and chain\-of\-custody documentation. A current California phlebotomy certificate or another credential authorizing venipuncture is required if the coordinator will perform blood draws.
* ACRP or SOCRA certification.
* Experience with early\-phase, oncology, metabolic health, longevity, infusion, decentralized, or investigator\-initiated research.
* Experience with EDC, CTMS, eRegulatory, electronic source, specimen tracking, or participant\-engagement systems.

  

**Benefits**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (Kaiser HMO or BlueShield PPO. Employer pays 85% for Employee and 50% for Employee’s family; Dental: Aetna Dental, Delta Dental, Guardian Dental, MetLife Dental. Vision: VSP and Aetna EyeMed)
* Basic life ($20,000 paid by company) and supplemental life insurance (optional supplemental).
* Disability insurance 50% standard employer paid.
* 401k 10% 1:1 match
* PTO policy. 10 days PTO
* Companywide paid holiday during: Week of July 4, Thanksgiving (2 days), Week of December 25
* Carpool, clean air vehicle, and cell phone reimbursement
* Employee rewards and recognition program
* Company organized social events
* Quarterly sponsored team building activities

new_jobs.title: Community Outreach Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Community Outreach Coordinator**
----------------------------------


Court Appointed Special Advocates (CASA) of San Mateo County offers a unique opportunity for passionate individuals to make a real difference in the lives of children and youth involved in foster care and the juvenile justice system. By joining our dynamic team, volunteers build long\-lasting relationships with young people, serving as both trusted mentors and powerful advocates within the courtroom and beyond. At CASA, we recruit, train, and empower dedicated volunteers to work one\-on\-one with youth, building meaningful relationships that help transform futures. Our volunteers are trusted mentors and powerful advocates in court and beyond, offering much\-needed stability for children facing uncertain times.


CASA’s office is in Redwood City, CA.


#### **Position Overview**



As our **Community Outreach Coordinator**, you'll be the face of our mission, sparking connections with prospective volunteers and community organizations to grow the network of volunteers who change young lives. In this outward\-facing, communications, driven role, you'll design and lead an active recruitment strategy that reaches new volunteers both virtually and in person, often serving as the very first impression someone has of our organization. This dynamic position calls for a confident communicator who's energized by public engagement and community building, with some evening and weekend availability to meet volunteers where they are. If you're passionate about relationship\-building and driven to expand our community of changemakers, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


The ideal candidate is bilingual and biliterate in Spanish and English, with exceptional interpersonal and motivational communication skills. They bring experience creating volunteer recruitment materials, are highly organized and detail\-oriented, particularly with paperwork and scheduling, and are comfortable researching, analyzing, and compiling data. Has sound judgment, collaborates well with team members, and can think on their feet. Genuine passion for the organization's mission (volunteers can sense authenticity). Patience and flexibility, since volunteer availability and commitment levels vary widely. Ability to make people feel valued and see the tangible impact of their time


**Reports to:** Senior Program Manager\-Initiative, Training and Recruitment


**Status:** Full \-time, non\-exempt; 40 hours per week with occasional evening and weekend work required


**Location:** Redwood City, CA\- Hybrid work schedule with two days in the office and occasional travel to off\-site locations for presentations and events.


#### **Duties and Responsibilities**


* Build and maintain volunteer pipeline:
* Develop and implement a comprehensive volunteer recruitment plan to recruit a diverse pool of volunteers to serve as Court Appointed Special Advocates based on waitlist needs and current volunteer pool.
* Coordinate organizational efforts to recruit a diverse pool of volunteers to (1\) provide culturally and linguistically sensitive services to the youth CASA supports and to (2\) ensure that the organization has a volunteer pool with individuals with diverse backgrounds.
* Identify and establish relationships and promote volunteer opportunities with local community organizations, corporations, associations, collaborations, and networks that act as natural volunteer recruitment sources.
* Build ongoing relationships with community organizations, businesses, and schools as recurring volunteer pipelines.
* Schedule and coordinate orientations, this includes ensuring information is updated, current, and correct on website and other public documentation and delivery of information.
* Process volunteer applications including entering and verifying information is accurate and complete for each prospective trainee on agency database, tracking prospective trainee information, and identifying and reporting to the Program Team on any issues regarding candidates.
* Collaborate with the Development Team to develop and produce recruitment and outreach materials, including PowerPoints, flyers, banners, and both digital and hard copy collateral, as well as contribute to broader organizational marketing and awareness materials beyond volunteer recruitment. This includes Spanish\-language versions.
* Partner with the Development and Program teams to create social media content that supports both volunteer recruitment and CASA's broader organizational marketing, awareness, and engagement efforts, coordinating translation support as needed.
* Design or coordinate recruitment campaign materials with design/marketing teams when available, ensuring materials support broader outreach efforts.
* Ensure all recruitment and outreach materials reflect a consistent employer brand voice and messaging, in compliance with EEO/equal opportunity language requirements.
* Identify and engage candidates through volunteer pipelines, LinkedIn, referrals, networking events, and databases, including proactive outreach to passive candidates.
* Present to external audiences to recruit volunteers, raise awareness, engage corporate and community partners, and raise the profile of CASA of San Mateo County.
* Plan and host community events and outreach activities that raise awareness of CASA's mission and create multiple pathways for community involvement.
	+ Special events and projects, as required.
* Develop strategies to improve volunteer pipeline from first contact through long\-term service.
* Research and document current recruitment and retention practices.
* Analyze pipeline data to identify where volunteers drop off and manage a defined schedule of touch points that keeps volunteers engaged and tracked at every stage.
* Use outcome and attrition data to identify the highest\-drop\-off phases, especially application and assignment, and to develop targeted strategies to close those gaps.

new_jobs.title: Events & Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Events \& Operations Specialist**

  

Job Title: Events and Operations Specialist
Department: Strategic Partnerships \& University Relations (SPUR)
Reports to: Vice President for Strategic Partnerships \& University Relations
Location: Residential, In\-Person
Employment Status: Full\-Time Exempt Staff
Salary Range: $60,000 \- $90,000
About Palo Alto University (PAU)


Palo Alto University is a private, nonprofit university dedicated to advancing human understanding through innovative education, groundbreaking research, and impactful practice in behavioral science.


Founded in 1975 and located in the heart of Silicon Valley, PAU offers graduate and undergraduate programs in psychology, counseling, social work, and behavioral science, including the PAU\-Stanford PsyD Consortium with Stanford Medicine. Grounded in human dignity, PAU's scholars, clinicians, educators, and learners share a single conviction: that understanding how people think, feel, behave, relate, heal, and make meaning is among the most essential work of our time.


The university enrolls over 1,200 students, has a network of more than 4,200 alumni, and employs over 150 faculty and staff united by a mission\-driven commitment to advancing human understanding. PAU enters its sixth decade at a defining moment: a new president, a new provost, a bold new vision and strategic plan, and an urgent opportunity to shape how behavioral science responds to the challenges of an increasingly changing world. You will join a mission\-driven community with the ambition to make a measurable impact on the human condition.

  

The Role
Reporting to the Vice President for Strategic Partnerships and University Relations, the Events and Operations Specialist is the production engine of SPUR's advancement event portfolio. This is a new role in a new and growing division, with growth potential as PAU's event calendar matures and expands.


The Specialist produces and executes events with precision, care, and institutional pride. Within SPUR, the functional Director owns the purpose, audience, content, and relationship strategy of every event. The Specialist owns project management, logistics, production, and execution of every event in the portfolio.


The right candidate is energized by complexity, thrives under deadline pressure, takes genuine pride in flawless execution, and understands that in advancement, events cultivate donors, partnerships, relationships, and brand. This is a focused, high\-impact production role at the center of PAU's most consequential external moments.

  

Responsibilities
Event Production and Logistics Management

* Own the end\-to\-end production and logistics of SPUR's core advancement events, including the Annual Gala, President's Circle meetings and dinners, donor and partnership cultivation gatherings, alumni engagement events, and community convenings.
* Manage all event logistics, including venue selection and contracting, catering, audiovisual, signage, transportation, accommodations, staffing, accessibility, and on\-site coordination, ensuring every event is executed seamlessly and reflects PAU's institutional standards.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive event production timelines, run\-of\-show documents, vendor contracts, budget tracking, and post\-event debrief reports for every event in the SPUR portfolio.
* Serve as the primary on\-site coordinator for all advancement events, managing setup, vendor relationships, staff and volunteer coordination, and real\-time problem resolution to ensure every event runs without disruption.
* Build and maintain a preferred vendor network of caterers, venues, audiovisual providers, photographers, printers, and event technology partners that reflects PAU's commitment to quality, value, and mission alignment.


Commencement Week Planning and Execution

* Lead the full production and logistics of PAU's annual commencement week, a multi\-day celebration and advancement cultivation series culminating in the commencement ceremony itself. SPUR owns the planning and full implementation of commencement as an advancement event. The University Registrar and Academic Affairs support degree conferral logistics, student participation lists, and academic ceremony protocol.
* Design and execute a week\-long calendar of cultivation activities, community gatherings, student and family celebrations, donor receptions, and community engagement events that position commencement as PAU's most important annual advancement moment and the first touchpoint of every graduate's alumni life.
* Coordinate with the University Registrar solely on degree conferral logistics, student participation lists, and academic ceremony protocol.
* Own the full commencement event experience, including regalia management, speaker invitations, procession planning, security, media coordination, cultivation programming, and community engagement dimensions of the week.
* Develop commencement week invitation and RSVP management systems for students, families, alumni, donors, partners, faculty, and community guests, ensuring every constituent receives a personalized, timely, and welcoming communication.
* Partner with the Director of Alumni Relations to design cultivation activities during commencement week that introduce graduating students to the alumni community and engage families and parents as prospective donors and institutional advocates.
* Coordinate with the Director of Development to identify and steward donor and prospect touchpoints during commencement week, ensuring high\-priority cultivation relationships receive intentional, personalized engagement throughout the celebration.


Silicon Valley Convenings and Thought Leadership Events

* Once the Director of Strategic Partnerships, VP, or President establishes the strategic objective, target audience, and relationship goals for a convening, own full production from that point forward, translating the strategic vision into a logistically flawless eve

new_jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator, Organic Content
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

Aahana Medical Aesthetics is a new physician\-led medical aesthetics practice opening in Dogpatch in February 2027\. It is founded and run by a board\-certified physician. Small team, high standards, and a real point of view about skin.

**THE** **ROLE**

We are looking for someone to own our organic social media. Instagram and TikTok mainly. You will be the person who captures what happens in the clinic and turns it into something people actually want to watch.

This is a part\-time role and it starts before we open. The first few months are about building an audience from zero, so early content is build\-out progress, education, and behind the scenes as we get the space ready. Once we open, you are in the clinic capturing treatments and results.

**WHAT** **YOU** **WILL** **DO**

\- Plan and run the content calendar for Instagram and TikTok

\- Shoot on site, mostly on an iPhone. Short form video, before and afters, treatment explainers, team moments

\- Edit and post. Captions, hooks, covers, audio

\- Write in our voice. Warm, clear, no hype and no fear\-mongering

\- Reply to comments and direct messages, and pass real enquiries to the front desk

\- Tell us what is working. Saves, shares, watch time, profile visits, not just follower count

\- Coordinate with our paid ads and search agency so organic and paid do not contradict each other

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

\- You have run a social account that grew, and you can show it. A personal account counts

\- You can shoot and edit yourself. CapCut, Instagram Reels or similar

\- You write well and fast

\- You are comfortable on a clinic floor and around patients, and you understand that privacy is not negotiable

\- Interest in skincare, beauty or healthcare. You do not need clinical experience, we will teach you what you need to know

**NICE TO HAVE**

\- Experience in aesthetics, dermatology, beauty or wellness

\- Basic design skills, Canva is fine

\- Comfortable on camera yourself

**ONE THING THAT IS NOT NEGOTIABLE**

Everything we post is governed by patient privacy law. You will be trained on HIPAA, the federal health privacy law, and on California's own medical privacy rules. You will not post a patient photo, name or detail without a signed authorization in hand. Every other part of this job is flexible. That part is not.

**COMPENSATION**

$28 to $35 per hour depending on experience. Roughly 12\-15 hours per week to start, with room to grow as we open.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Email careers@aahanaskin.com with a short note about why this job and links to two or three accounts or posts you made. No cover letter needed. Tell us what you would post in our first month.

Pay: $28\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94107

----------------


Our mission is to make it simple to headquarter any business on the internet. Today, we provide companies with a business address and a dashboard to manage their physical mail online. Over 15,000\+ companies like Brex, Doordash, and Gusto use Stable to automate their mailroom and act as their permanent business address with the IRS, state, and vendors.


The rules that regulate US entities were written in the 1800s. Stable abstracts these antiquated requirements with tools that empower modern companies to move forward faster.


These rules don't make sense for the way we work today — work takes place in the cloud and businesses are no longer tied to physical proximity or geography.


We’re on a mission to fix the broken system of entity management. Starting with business addresses and mail, we’re abstracting the complex, archaic systems that make company\-building painful and turning them into delightful experiences — so that modern businesses have the tools they need to move forward faster.


We're backed by leading Silicon Valley investors like Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Shakti, Hustle Fund, and founders from companies like Lattice, Apartment List, and FlexJobs.


Our business is at an inflection point. We’re growing quickly with a product people love and we’ve proven we can service companies of all stages and industries — from early\-stage startups to publicly traded companies in industries like technology, logistics, and property management.

**Role**

**As an SDR**, you will identify, research, and engage with potential customers who could benefit from Stable’s solutions. Your role will be critical in driving awareness, generating leads, and building the foundation for Stable’s sales success.

**About Open Standard**


Open Standard is on a mission to build the world's best money, starting with the US dollar. We believe money should move the way data does: instantly, globally, at any hour, in any amount. Today, financial transactions are hindered by delays, fees, and inefficiencies that every business must bear. We’re here to change that.


Our flagship product, Open USD, is a stablecoin designed for the internet: programmable, global, and built to reward the businesses that champion its adoption. Launched in close partnership with industry leaders like Stripe, Visa, Mastercard, Coinbase, and Shopify, Open Standard already has over 200 top companies in its network. Our lean team is based in San Francisco and New York and is led by Zach Abrams, who co\-founded Bridge (acquired by Stripe for $1\.1B) and previously led product at Brex, Coinbase, and Square.


Money is the world's most foundational product. Join us to help redefine it.

**Your role**


As Open Standard’s first Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in bringing the world’s largest banks, payment companies, and fintechs onto the Open USD platform. From the day a partner signs, you will become their main point of contact, guiding them through integration, launch, and every stage of future growth. You’ll collaborate closely with product teams at our founding partners, including Stripe, Coinbase, Visa, and Mastercard, whose customers will be among the first to use Open USD.


This is an exciting opportunity to help shape Open Standard’s partner experience, take our earliest partnerships live, and convert a network of signed partners into a community of deeply engaged adopters.

**What you'll do**

* Launch new partners quickly by coordinating across Legal, Product, Compliance, and integration teams, ensuring launches happen in days, not weeks
* Develop tailored growth plans with each partner: define how Open USD fits their business, project transaction volumes for the first year, and identify key success drivers; lead quarterly reviews with partner leadership
* Connect partners within the network to foster collaboration and unlock new value as more companies adopt Open USD
* Serve as the single point of contact for partners after signing: manage launch announcements, handle reporting questions, and involve internal teams (Finance, Legal, Product) as needed
* Own the partner demand picture: build and maintain partner\-level forecasts that guide Liquidity, Finance, and Product planning
* Continuously improve our onboarding and product by turning every partner’s experience into future best practices and enhancements

**You may be a good fit if you**

* Have experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking\-as\-a\-service platform
* Have worked in a network or marketplace business where facilitating participant connections was part of your role
* Possess enough technical fluency to lead integration calls without needing a dedicated solutions engineer

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking\-as\-a\-service platform (if not already mentioned above)
* Additional technical expertise to independently own integration conversations

**Logistics**

* **Location:** San Francisco or New York, hybrid with a mix of in\-office and remote days

**Come work with us**


Open Standard is headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York. We’re a small, senior, and entrepreneurial team with high autonomy and trust. If our mission excites you and you meet most of the qualifications, we want to hear from you.


Compensation Range: $175K \- $210K

new_jobs.title: Entry Level Account Manager - Chicago, IL
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary:** Medical Diagnostic Laboratories (MDL), a member of Genesis Global Group, is a CLIA certified clinical laboratory with multiple state licensing, specializing in state of the art, automated DNA based molecular analysis of a variety of chronic and infectious illnesses.
  
  

MDL specializes and performs Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) with a larger menu of testing available in the field of infectious disease. Our main theme of research is in the field of Gynecology, Infectious Diseases, Infectious Arthritis, Tick\-borne Diseases, Mycology, and Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS).
  
  

MDL is looking to expand its sales force throughout the U.S. We are seeking a high\-energy, self\-motivated individual to join our sales team. As an Entry Level Account Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining a large client base of existing customers for MDL and serve as a liaison between management and customers to resolve any customer issues.
  
  

**Essential Functions:**  

* Grow client base revenues by presenting new test information, up selling and seeking out new sources of revenue from existing clients
* Establish positive long\-term client relations
* Educate and train clients, research problems and coordinate solutions between the laboratory and client
* Work closely with Senior Sales Executive and Regional Manager to identify client concerns and assist in the development and implementation of client retention strategies
* Monitor, evaluate, and report level of client satisfaction and recommend appropriate corrective action as required
* Maintain knowledge of competitors and their presence in assigned territory


**Job Qualifications:** General Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA’s) required
  
* 1\-3 years of successful customer service experience.
* Well\-developed multi\-tasking, organizational skills, and detail orientation are key to success
* Energy, motivation, enthusiasm, and integrity
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Must demonstrate sound judgment and decision\-making ability
* Computer proficiency in MS Office, Excel, e\-mail and internet functions
* Knowledge of laboratory testing and competing products.
* Must be able to travel within the coverage area and occasionally nationwide


**Physical Demands:** Physical, Mental and Workplace Environment Conditions
  
* Use hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools, or controls
* Ability to sit, stand and walk
* Ability to drive motor vehicle


**Workplace Conditions:** Workplace Environment Conditions
  
* Requires frequent traveling by motor vehicle
* May be exposed to various workplace environments when meeting with customers


**Education and Certifications:**  

* Medical Assistant certification or Associate Degree, BA/BS preferred.


**We Offer:**  

* Competitive Salary
* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Life Insurance
* Dependent Care Flex Spending Account
* Voluntary Policies (Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness \& Supplemental STD)
* Identity Theft Protection
* 401(k) Plan
* Paid Vacation \& Holiday
* Business Professional Environment


Visit us at https://www.mdlab.com/
  
  

Medical Diagnostic Laboratories is a member of Genesis Global Group, an equal opportunity employer.
